Approval of remote and hybrid work is not guaranteed regardless of work location. For additional information on remote work at Penn State, see Notice to Out of State Applicants.

POSITION SPECIFICS

Your working location will be fully on-site located in State College, PA. This role requires periodic travel to remote locations.

The Systems and Emerging Capabilities Division in the Undersea Systems Office (USO) at the Applied Research Laboratory (ARL) is seeking a Department Head for Autonomy and Emerging Technology (AET). This department is an innovation hub for our Systems Engineering Division. The AET Department’s primary mission is to develop, test, and evaluate emerging capabilities in the Subsea and Seabed (SSW) mission area. It's secondary mission is to rapidly evaluate and field test new and emerging capabilities applicable to SSW – including testing of systems, payloads, and software. This position may be filled as either a Research and Development Engineer or a non-tenure Research Faculty.

Research areas include, but not limited to:

Autonomy for Unmanned Vehicles (UxVs), including autonomy architectures, behaviors, mission planning, and autonomy standards that improve reliability, endurance, and mission effectiveness in challenging maritime environments.
Payloads/payload delivery of effects
Sensor/sensor integration
Navigation

ARL is an authorized DoD SkillBridge partner and welcomes all transitioning military members to apply.

You will:

Technical Leadership - Lead innovation in SSW mission area to include autonomy for UxVs, including adaptive mission behaviors, environmental awareness, distributed autonomy, multi-vehicle coordination, and integration of autonomy with UxV sensors and payloads. Drive advancements in UxV simulation, field testing, and fleet-relevant autonomy capabilities
Programmatic Leadership - Oversee SSW-focused UxV programs and multidisciplinary teams working across undersea navigation, endurance optimization, acoustic communications, environmental modeling, and autonomy-enabled CONOPS. Collaborate closely with ARL’s SSW Portfolio Manager and sponsors to shape new SSW research directions
Resource Management - Align personnel and technical resources—including UxV test assets, autonomy laboratories, software infrastructure, and field test facilities—with program needs and strategic priorities
Personnel Management - Mentor engineers and researchers specializing in UxV autonomy, control systems, undersea sensing, navigation, and environmental modeling. Foster growth in mission-focused undersea autonomy competencies
Department Management - Ensure effective planning and execution of programs involving system integration, sea testing, autonomy software development, mission simulation and evaluation, and cross-domain unmanned systems collaboration
Collaboration - Work across ARL departments to integrate autonomy with undersea vehicles, sensors, communications, and emerging technologies. Partner with oceanography, acoustics, guidance & control, and materials experts to develop next-generation UxV capabilities
New Business – Must be entrepreneurial in nature. You will need to work with the SSW Portfolio manager to create and shape new UxV autonomy research opportunities. Help develop seedling efforts in areas such areas as: long-duration UxV autonomy, autonomous behaviors for complex missions, resilient undersea communications autonomy, and cross-domain unmanned vehicle coordination
Customer Interaction – Engage directly with Navy sponsors, DoD collaborators, and other stakeholders to present UxV autonomy advancements, field-test results, and new capability concepts. Represent ARL at autonomy and undersea systems conferences and technical reviews

Required Skills/Experience areas include:

Past success managing technical teams and programs
Strong decision-making skills in complex technical and operational environments.
Autonomy for unmanned systems including: autonomy architectures, behavior frameworks and mission planning for undersea missions, undersea navigation and perception autonomy behaviors, autonomy standards for UxVs (e.g., MOSA, A-GRA, UMAA, PCX), UXV simulation, evaluation, and verification environments
DEVSECOPS approaches used for government autonomy and control software
Test and evaluation of maritime platforms
Current eligibility for access to classified information at the Top Secret level or higher and may be subject to a government background investigation to upgrade clearance eligibility, if required

Preferred Skills/Experience areas include:

UxV systems, including platforms, mission payloads, launch and recovery, acoustic comms, and energy management
Oceanography, seabed features, and environmental data used for UxV autonomy
Past success supporting Navy missions, operational training, or UxV fleet experimentation
Development or use of UxV simulation frameworks (e.g., high-fidelity hydrodynamic or environmental modeling)
Principal Investigator or business development experience in UxV or autonomy programs
AI/ML methods applied to UxV navigation, perception, environmental characterization, mission planning, or anomaly detection
Past success managing technical personnel in undersea systems or autonomy fields

Minimum Education, Work Experience & Required Certifications

If filled as R&D Engineer, Department Head (ARL) - Principal Professional, this position requires: Bachelor's Degree - Engineering or Science 19+ years of relevant experience Required Certifications: None If filled as R&D Engineer, Department Head (ARL) - Advanced Professional, this position requires: Bachelor's Degree - Engineering or Science 5+ years of relevant experience Required Certifications: None If filled as R&D Engineer, Department Head (ARL) - Senior Professional, this position requires: Bachelor's Degree - Engineering or Science 14+ years of relevant experience Required Certifications: None

ARL’s purpose is to research and develop innovative solutions to challenging scientific, engineering, and technology problems in support of the Navy, the Intel Community (IC), and other federal government customers.

www.arl.psu.edu
.

ARL operates in a secure information environment involving Unclassified, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), and Classified information. Menlo Park, CA OR Fremont, CA

: $180K Base to $230K Base + 20% QPLC

Mandatory skills: Oracle, Full Stack, Supply Chain, Production Support (Ticket Resolution), People Leadership, and to have an Engineering background.

About the Role
The Supply Chain Engineering Domain Director L1 is the single accountable technical delivery owner for the application portfolio supporting supply chain, product lifecycle, demand and supply planning, order and inventory management, logistics, and supplier/ODM collaboration. As a managed service partner to the client, this role owns the full application lifecycle which designs, developments, integrations, and production support and leads the engineering team that delivers it.

The role is part software delivery leadership, part trusted advisor on where the Supply Chain technology estate goes next. The portfolio is a hybrid 1P/3P estate combining vendor SaaS with custom-built internal applications, so fluency in Full Stack Engineering (PHP/React), deep integration layers, 3P technologies (Oracle, O9, Teamcenter) and master data layers between them is essential.

Key Responsibilities
End-to-End Software Delivery Ownership
Own delivery accountability for the Supply Chain application portfolio — design, build, integrations, testing, release, and L2/L3 production support.
Own service commitments (SLAs/SLOs, incident response, change management, release calendar) and act as escalation point for major technical incidents and critical defects.

Operational & Strategic Leadership

added.title: Head of Product Engineering
added.description:
About Reducto

Reducto is the agentic document platform for leading AI teams who demand enterprise performance at scale. We provide a comprehensive toolkit for working with documents the way a human would, combining custom in-house and leading frontier models to power efficient and accurate document workflows.

We’ve grown rapidly, increasing revenue 8x year over year and partnering with hundreds of companies, from leading AI teams like Harvey, Vanta, and Scale, to enterprise customers across FAANG and top trading firms.

Reducto has raised over $100M from world-class investors including a16z, Benchmark, and First Round Capital.

The Role

As we've worked with customers to solve their most pressing document intelligence problems, we've started building a universe of products and tooling that can help customers through the entire lifecycle of their document workflows. We're hiring a Head of Product Engineering to lead the engineering team building these products. You'll set direction for what we build on top of our models, and be accountable for the product feeling fast, reliable, precise, and worth paying for. You'll define how we build products, from what technologies we use to how we apply them.

This is a hands-on role. We think the best product leaders at our stage lead from inside the codebase, so you'll spend your first few months shipping as an engineer on the team before you fully take on leading it. As AI makes it easier to write code, the expectation that you can solve the hard problems yourself becomes more of the norm.

You'll report to our VP of Engineering and work directly with our founders.

We Would Love To Meet You If You:

Product Intuition: You have a sharp eye for what good product looks like and how it's built. You care about the details that matter and think with first principles.
Quality: You deeply care about the quality of what you build and ship. You hold your team to a demanding quality bar. You're allergic to AI slop.
Experience: You have 3+ years of experience leading team(s) that have built applications with significant impact. You've led business-critical projects from 0 to 1 but also from 1 to 100. You prefer to lead small, nimble teams.
Approach: A quantitative approach to building products. Ability to debug, experiment, and iterate fast. You should be comfortable getting hands-on with the full development lifecycle, from ideation to shipping production-quality code.
Ambiguity: You work well in environments that have ambiguity. We believe ex-founders are the best fit for this role as they have the skills to navigate ambiguity, but it's not a requirement.
Customers: You've worked directly with customers before. You have experience doing customer discovery or customer research.

The Core Work Will Include:

Working directly with our founders, product team, and our customers to shape what products we build and how we build them
Creating delightful, intuitive UIs that elegantly decomposes complex document workflows
Ideating, prototyping and iteratively delivering new features like form filling, translations, document editing and document classification
Sourcing and recruiting product engineers who will build a world-class agentic document platform
Defining how we use AI in our building process
Working closely with our Platform and ML engineering teams to roll out new models and deployment capabilities

Bonus points if you

Have founded a company that has experienced meaningful traction
Have experience deploying agentic workflows to customers
Prior experience working with document workflows
Have built with LLMs in production, including evaluation tooling
Have held a tech-lead-manager or player-coach role at a company that experienced rapid growth

This is an in person role at our office in SF. We're an early stage company which means that the role requires working hard and moving quickly. Please only apply if that excites you.

About Reducto

Nearly 80% of enterprise data is in unstructured formats like PDFs

PDFs are the status quo for enterprise knowledge in nearly every industry. Insurance claims, financial statements, invoices, and health records are all stored in a structure that’s simply impractical for use in digital workflows. This isn’t an inconvenience—it’s a critical bottleneck that leads to dozens of wasted hours every week.

Traditional approaches fail at reliably extracting information in complex PDFs

OCR and even more sophisticated ML approaches work for simple text documents but are unreliable for anything more complex. Text from different columns are jumbled together, figures are ignored, and tables are a nightmare to get right. Overcoming this usually requires a large engineering effort dedicated to building specialized pipelines for every document type you work with.

Reducto Breaks Document Layouts Into Subsections And Then Contextually Parses Each Depending On The Type Of Content. This Is Made Possible By a Combination Of Vision Models, LLMs, And a Suite Of Heuristics We Built Over Time. Put Simply, We Can Help You:

Accurately extract text and tables even with nonstandard layouts
Automatically convert graphs to tabular data and summarize images in documents
Extract important fields from complex forms with simple, natural language instructions
Build powerful retrieval pipelines using Reducto’s document metadata
Intelligently chunk information using the document’s layout data

Benefits at Reducto

At Reducto, we’re invested in the well-being and growth of our team. Here’s what we currently offer:

Unlimited PTO: We believe great work requires recharging.
Lunch: Receive a free lunch to eat with your teammates daily at the office
Reimbursed Transportation: Provide us with your receipts and we’ll take care of the costs
Insurance: Generous health insurance covering medical, dental, and vision.
Health and Wellness Budget: We provide up to $150/mo reimbursement for health and wellness spending, such as gym memberships, fitness classes, or similar.
Parental Leave: Work with us to build a leave schedule that works for you and your family

added.title: Vice President of System Planning & Distribution Engineering
added.description:
Southern Maryland Electric Cooperative (SMECO) has an immediate opening for a Vice President of System Planning & Distribution Engineering. This position ensures the Cooperative's electric system is configured, engineered, constructed, and operated in a manner that maintains normal and contingency facility capacity margins, operational flexibility, system reliability, and safety while meeting customer-member, PJM, PSC, and NERC reliability expectations. The Vice President oversees distribution system protection and sectionalizing practices, system studies, software model development, and electric system interconnections. This position provides leadership for customer-member initiated commercial service projects from initial concept through project closeout, including customer interaction, project management, documentation, coordination of distribution design activities, right-of-way acquisition, material readiness, permitting, construction coordination, billing, and project closeout processes. This position directs the preparation of engineering and design capital improvement projects, develops circuit protection and sectionalizing directives, prepares project scope documentation, and serves as the subject matter expert (SME) liaison for engineering, right-of-way, and construction project coordination activities that enhance the Cooperative's electric system.

The Vice President is responsible for directing the development of Cooperative electric system studies and reports, including Construction Work Plans (CWP), Electric System Plans (ESP), system loss studies, power flow studies, short circuit studies, protective coordination studies, sectionalizing studies, outage contingency studies, and motor start/flicker studies.

The position manages the coordination, evaluation, and approval of customer generation interconnection requests in compliance with NERC, PJM, PSC interconnection regulations, IEEE Standards, the National Electrical Code (NEC), and the best practices in industry.

The Vice President also oversees GIS modeling, mapping, and geomatics functions to ensure accurate electric system maps, schematics, diagrams, land base information, physical structure locations, and data exports that support Cooperative business modeling, outage management systems, and construction processes.

This position directs investigations related to electric system disturbances, including line and station power flows, equipment application, inspection and installation, circuit performance and configuration, system fault current values, line conductor characteristics, and radio frequency interference (RFI) issues.

Additional responsibilities include overseeing Cooperative standards, materials, contract administration, joint-use activities, material reconciliation, workflow closeout processes, and directing the preparation, verification, analysis, summarization, and dissemination of system-related information and reports for government agencies, industry organizations, and utility partners. The position ensures system planning and construction activities comply with NERC and Maryland Public Service Commission guidelines, maintains required records, and participates in NERC audits.

This position requires a Bachelor of Science degree from an ABET accredited engineering college or university in an engineering discipline is required, with some business administration, computer, management services, power systems engineering, and technical writing courses preferred. Registration as a Professional Engineer in the State of Maryland is essential. Candidates with registrations from states maintaining reciprocity with Maryland must obtain Maryland Registration within one year of employment. AEE Energy Manager Certification (CEM) or advanced graduate degree is desired

The candidate must have fifteen or more years of increasingly responsible experience in the engineering, construction, or operations department of an electric utility or engineering consulting firm, with supervision preferred. Proven familiarity with electric utility transmission, station, and distribution facility design, planning, construction, operations, maintenance, specifications, power systems software, and accounting / administrative principles and practices are required.
The starting salary range for this position is $162,100 - $226,400. SMECO offers an excellent benefits program including a 401(k) 6% dollar for dollar match and an additional 3% non-elective company contribution.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
SMECO champions a culture where people are valued and employee experience is driven by innovation, collaboration, inclusion, safety, and trust. Interested candidates should apply via SMECO’s website at www.smeco.coop/about/careers .

Determine appropriate staffing levels for forecasted business and schedules staff members accordingly. Review work schedules and estimate staff members hour requirements for completion of job assignment.

added.title: Vice President of Engineering
added.description:
Vice President of Engineering

Ready to build what’s next with one of the world’s most iconic brands?

Why Join Subway?

At Subway, we are not standing still. We are building.

This is a business focused on what matters most: growing franchisee profitability, strengthening our brand and creating long-term value. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to make a real impact.

You will not just do the work. You will shape it.

We move fast. We think like owners. We make decisions that matter. We hold ourselves to a high standard because what we do directly impacts thousands of franchisees around the world.

If you bring energy, accountability and a bias for action, you will fit right in.

We take the work seriously, but we also know the best results come from teams that support each other, celebrate wins and show up ready to build something better every day.

This is your chance to be part of what’s next.

The Role

Subway is looking for a Vice President of Engineering to lead the engineering organization behind our franchisee-facing in-restaurant experience — the Point-of-sale, Menu management, Payments and other applications that connect them. This leader is accountable for the outcomes of that organization: what it ships, what it costs, how reliable it is, and how well it develops and retains its people. You'll own technical strategy, the engineering budget, and org design for a team of roughly 50, partnering closely with the Chief Technology Officer and product leadership to turn roadmap into results guests can feel.

This is a full-scope leadership role, not a technical execution role. Beyond architecture and delivery, you'll run the budget, own the tooling and cloud spend, shape the org chart as it scales, and build the culture and hygiene that separate a strong engineering organization from one that just ships code.

What You'll Own

POS: deployed in 39 countries, including release quality, performance, and store configuration with peripherals including Kitchen Display Systems, Printers, Cash Drawers.
Menu Management: the menu platform that feeds POS and other channels.
Payments applications for both in-store payments and digital payments
A number of applications that support franchisees including restaurant management, learning platform, etc.
The engineering relationship with our digital and corporates systems, including integration, data flow, and roadmap delivery.
Cloud infrastructure: our AWS and Azure environments — Lambda, Fargate, DynamoDB, Azure SQL — including architecture decisions on scalability, resilience, and cost.
Technical support: the team and processes that keep franchisee-facing properties running, including incident response and escalation.

How You'll Lead

Technical Strategy & Delivery

Set technical strategy and architecture direction across the franchisee engineering teams — and own what it delivers, not just how it's staffed.
Own the roadmap-to-delivery pipeline: planning, prioritization, release management, and the tradeoffs between feature work, reliability, and technical debt.
Make and defend build-vs-buy and platform decisions across the AWS stack, balancing scalability, resilience, security, and cost.

Budget & Cost Management

Own the engineering budget end to end — headcount cost, tooling and SaaS spend, and Azure/AWS cloud spend — and run it like a P&L, not a request line.
Own vendor economics for Azure, AWS, and other engineering tools: negotiate, benchmark, and cut what isn't earning its cost.
Build the annual headcount and budget plan with the Chief Technology Officer, and re-forecast it as priorities shift.
Know your unit economics — cost per release, cost per engineer, cloud cost per active user — and use them to make decisions, not just report them.

People, Culture & Org Design

Design and evolve the org structure as the team scales — spans of control, management layers, when to split or merge teams — rather than defaulting to the structure you inherit.
Own the full people lifecycle for your organization: hiring, onboarding, career development and promotion, performance management, and retention of your best people.
Build a culture of ownership and accountability, where engineers and managers own outcomes rather than tickets, and problems surface early rather than late.
Directly manage and develop your engineering managers and directors; own their growth and the health of their teams.

Engineering Practices & Reliability

Own incident management and on-call: response, escalation, postmortems, and the follow-through that prevents repeat incidents.
Set and hold the bar on code review, testing, documentation, and security practices across the organization.
Own capacity planning and technical debt — make the tradeoff between roadmap and system health explicit and defensible, rather than letting debt accumulate by default.
Establish the SLAs/SLOs that matter for a guest-facing digital platform, and own the outcome when they're missed.

Executive Partnership

Partner with the Chief Technology Officer and product leadership to translate business goals into engineering OKRs, and report against them in business terms, not activity terms.
Represent engineering in executive conversations — including tradeoffs, risk, and cost — with the same rigor you'd expect from a peer running a P&L.

What You Bring

10+ years in engineering leadership, including 5+ years managing managers within an organization of comparable scale (40+ engineers, including technical support).
Direct ownership of an engineering budget — headcount, tooling, and cloud spend — with a track record of running it like a P&L rather than a cost center.
Experience designing and evolving org structure as a team scales, not just operating within a structure someone else built.
Direct experience delivering consumer-facing mobile applications; React Native experience strongly preferred.
Hands-on architecture experience on AWS, including serverless and containerized services such as Lambda, Fargate, and DynamoDB.
Experience leading engineering for multi-unit retail or restaurant scale.
A demonstrated track record on the people side of engineering — hiring, developing, and holding a performance bar, including making the hard calls when someone isn't meeting it.
Strong partnership instincts — comfortable operating as a peer to product, marketing, and business stakeholders, and defending engineering's cost and priorities in those conversations.

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.

As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architect

ure and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.

Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.

Are you a talented Technical Engineering Leader looking for their next challenge? Do you have a passion for building cutting-edge enterprise products and a hands-on approach to engineering? Join Citi's Cloud Technology Services (CTS) team and be part of our commitment to transform Citi technology, leveraging game-changing Cloud capabilities to drive agility, efficiency, and innovation.

We are providing our businesses with a competitive edge by leveraging public cloud scale and enabling new infrastructure economics. As an Engineering Lead within the Network Infrastructure Team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing our public cloud strategy.

You will be part of a Public Cloud team that continues to deliver big by designing and managing the platform that enables the automated deployment of foundational resources globally across multiple public clouds. This foundation enables the business to deploy critical workloads, from building a cloud base High Performance Compute (HPC) platform to run huge risk calculations, enabling Citi to leverage GenAI at scale, all the way to enabling payment solutions, this team is at the forefront of innovation.

Role Description:

The ideal candidate will have experience of leading a team of talented engineers who are responsible for designing, certifying, deploying and securing network resources within AWS and GCP. The role requires a leader with strong technical skills and the ability to collaborate with stakeholders and partners throughout the full resource provisioning life cycle, from inception and design, to deployment, operational management and iterative refinement.

As an Engineering Lead within the Network Infrastructure Team, you will be responsible in developing strategy building on the existing platform architecture, delivering the tooling and services required to support the deployment and securing of cloud network resources.

The Network Infrastructure Team is based in multiple locations across the globe and comprises of Architects, Cloud Engineers and Security Engineers.

What you’ll do:

Strategic Vision: define and articulate a comprehensive vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the network engineering team, ensuring alignment with overall enterprise technology strategy and business objectives.
Team Development: work with the team and help develop the engineers technical and soft skills, create developments plans and support team member career aspirations.
Architectural Design: develop and maintain system architectures, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance.
Performance Optimization: monitor system performance and identify areas for optimization, ensuring efficient resource utilization.
Engineering Excellence: ensure the team follow engineering best practices and industry standards, using modern tooling that enables CI/CD and favors automation, auditability, automated testing, infrastructure and policy as code.
Collaborative Engineering: work with a talented team of cloud network and security engineers and full-stack software developers.
Innovate and Automate: identify and develop automated solutions as part of continual improvement to reduce the time to market of cloud services, enhancing client satisfaction and delivering business value.
Cross-Functional Partnership: collaborate with teams across Citi's technology landscape to ensure alignment between public cloud initiatives and broader business goals.
Compliance Advocacy: ensure adherence to relevant standards, policies and regulations, prioritizing the protection of Citi's reputation, clients and assets.

What we will need from you:

You will be a talented and experienced technical leader who has previously lead a cloud engineering team. You will have a proven track record of delivering critical and complex infrastructure. Your team is responsible for design, testing and deployment via Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

10+ years of progressive experience technical leader, strong technical skills with a significant experience leading a cloud engineering team.
Proven experience leading an engineering team in a complex dynamic corporate environment.
Expert level understanding of public cloud network infrastructure services available in AWS and GCP.
Expert level understanding of cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks in AWS and GCP.
Knowledge of Kubernetes, understanding of best practices relating to configuration including security and orchestration tools for AWS EKS and GCP GKE.
Knowledge of network and security theory, including router and firewall operations.
Experience of working with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) pipelines, including working with Terraform, Python and Go.

Your Role

The Sr. Manager, Engineering oversees a team responsible for designing and delivering complex services, integrations, cloud-native applications, and enterprise technology capabilities. This role partners across Product, Architecture, Security, Platform, Infrastructure, business, vendor, and senior leadership teams to align priorities, remove obstacles, and drive outcomes that support Stellarus’ mission and evolving technology strategy.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

Responsibilities

Your Work

In This Role, You Will

Lead an engineering team responsible for delivering secure, scalable, reliable technology solutions.
Define and execute engineering roadmaps, delivery priorities, operational plans, and team objectives aligned to business, product, platform, and enterprise goals.
Establish and improve operating models, governance, engineering standards, KPIs, dashboards, SLAs/SLOs, and executive-level reporting to show delivery health, platform maturity, operational performance, and business value.

Qualifications

Your Knowledge and Experience

Bachelor’s degree or High School Diploma/GED and 4 years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
8 years of progressive technology experience in software engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, enterprise engineering, engineering management, technical delivery, or related disciplines.

Strong knowledge of modern software engineering, platform engineering, cloud architecture, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, automation, AI enablement, APIs, secure development, and technology lifecycle management.

Experience modernizing enterprise platforms or applications, reducing technical debt, improving operational resilience, and maintaining secure, supportable technologies.

Experience with budget management, vendor management, contracts, investment planning, resource planning, and technology roadmaps preferred.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical concepts, tradeoffs, risks, and investment needs for senior and cross-functional audiences.
Experience supporting large-scale technology delivery in complex, regulated, healthcare, cloud-native, or platform-based environments preferred.

Hybrid

This role requires employees to be in-office based on our hybrid workplace model, balancing purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility. For most teams, this means coming into the office two days each week.

Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location will work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.

Stellarus, launched in January 2025, is designed to scale innovative healthcare solutions that support customers in creating a health care experience deserving of their family, friends, and neighbors.

Stellarus is part of a family of organizations that is overseen by a nonprofit corporate entity named Ascendiun. The Ascendiun Family of Companies also includes Blue Shield of California and its subsidiary, Blue Shield of California Promise Health Plan and Altais, a clinical services company.

Description

Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX), started in 2022, is working to make Amazon the best place to build software. Every day, hundreds of thousands of Amazon software builders rely on us for the tools they build with, and for the technology, training, and community behind them. One of our most important responsibilities is shaping the language ecosystem, both inside Amazon and across the open-source community, to improve the experience for every software builder.

The Role

We are seeking a Director of Software Development to lead Language Foundations, the organization that owns Amazon's programming-languages strategy across our strategic languages (Java, Rust, Python, TypeScript, Go, C/C++, Kotlin, and Swift) and represents that strategy to the language community: the engineers who specialize in language design, compilation, and optimization, along with standards bodies and the open-source ecosystems Amazon depends on. This leader recruits and leads some of the world's foremost language specialists, many of them Principal Engineers with deep standing in their fields.

Language Foundations shapes and influences the direction of the world's most critical programming languages. Amazon sits on the Rust Foundation board, is one of the distributors of OpenJDK (Amazon Corretto), and sponsors resident engineers who are among the top contributors in their communities. This leader is central to Amazon's large-scale language modernization, owning the tooling and language foundations that enable teams to move to modern languages and runtimes and transform the performance, efficiency, and safety of the software they run. It is simultaneously a community-shaping and an internal-modernization challenge: strengthening the ecosystems that Amazon and the industry rely on, while helping modernize some of the largest services in the world.

Key job responsibilities

Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Language Foundations, connecting it to builder impact: code quality, reliability, security, performance, and the enablement of agent-supervised development.
Deliver best-in-class support for Amazon's strategic languages (Java, Rust, Python, TypeScript, Go, C/C++, Kotlin, and Swift), aligning internal toolchains with industry conventions so builders and agents work on modern runtimes out of the box.
Lead Amazon's language modernization through the tooling and language foundations that transform the performance, efficiency, and safety of the software teams build and run, including large-scale Rust and Java runtime investments.
Build the trusted, secure repository for the third-party software Amazon depends on, curating out unmaintained and vulnerable dependencies so builders start from a safe default.
Shape the external direction of strategic programming languages through Amazon's participation in standards bodies, foundations (e.g., the Rust Foundation, OpenJDK), and the open-source community, while maintaining the cultural norms of those communities.
Lead and grow a multi-team engineering organization: recruit and develop world-class language specialists and Principal Engineers and build the leadership bench.
Influence strategy and technical direction at the most senior levels of the company through clear written narrative and data; briefs at CEO-level reviews.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent work experience.
10+ years of software development experience, including systems software, compilers, language runtimes, or developer toolchains.
5+ years managing people, with 3+ years managing multiple managers or teams.
Experience developing long-term technical vision and strategy and influencing leadership decisions.
Experience delivering large-scale technical programs across multiple teams or organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's or PhD in Computer Science or Engineering, with 10+ years of relevant experience.
A leadership position on a team delivering solutions at Amazon or industry scale.
Proven track record of attracting, developing, and retaining top language and systems specialists, including engineers with standing in the open-source community.
Active participation in the language community, including membership or leadership in standards bodies, foundations, or major open-source projects.
Deep expertise in programming language design, runtimes, compilers, or developer ecosystems, with recognized standing in the language community.
Experience leading large-scale language or platform migrations in complex, multi-service environments.

added.description:
Ready to leave your mark on the future of transportation in Ohio and beyond? GAI Consultants is seeking an accomplished Bridge Practice Lead
to lead and expand our growing Bridge Engineering Group within our Ohio Transportation Business Unit.

Backed by a robust and growing pipeline of projects with ODOT, OTIC, and local governments, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the region's infrastructure while leading a talented team of engineers.

As GAI continues to expand throughout Ohio and neighboring states, you'll collaborate on exciting projects across Indiana, West Virginia, and Pennsylvania, helping drive innovation and growth across the region. Enjoy the flexibility of remote or hybrid work arrangements
, along with a GENEROUS SIGN-ON BONUS
designed to welcome top talent to our team.

Job Duties:

Design and prepare plans, calculations, and specifications for transportation structures, including highway bridges, retaining walls, box culverts, and other miscellaneous structures per AASHTO and ODOT requirements.
Provide analysis and load rating for existing structures and recommend improvement and strengthening strategies through knowledge and application of appropriate specifications, standards, and design criteria,
Collaborate with other professionals from various departments and disciplines and discuss requirements with clients to execute projects.
Perform work as part of a team or as a task/project manager, in accordance with the project budget and schedule limitations under moderate supervision.
Prepare engineering cost estimates, the scope of work documents, and proposals and assist other Project/Task Managers with similar duties.
Provide leadership and technical guidance to the project team to ensure quality technical services.
Monitor and enforce compliance with quality control standards and client requirements.
Participate in occasional site visits in construction sites and remote outdoor work environments.
Occasional travel to client meetings and site visits with possible overnight stays.

General Characteristics

Applies broad knowledge of principles and practices in a specific practice area.
Independently evaluates, selects, and adapts standard techniques, procedures, and criteria.
Leads tasks and projects of moderately complex scopes.

Experience Required

20+ years

Education

B.S. or M.S. Engineering

Professional Engineer (P.E.) License, reciprocity in multiple states.

Technical Responsibilities

Assigns tasks to other technical and non-technical staff. Predominantly plans and coordinates detailed aspects of the engineering work.

Assists with proposals to provide professional services or obtain funding for engineering projects or projects.

Receives supervision and guidance relating to overall objectives, critical issues, new concepts, and policy matters.
Receives direction on unusual conditions and developments.
Mentor direct reports and other engineers.
Demonstrates professional attitudes relevant to the practice of engineering, including creativity, curiosity, flexibility, and dependability.

Communication Skills

Possesses advanced oral and written communication skills, including interpretation of complex technical and contractual language.
Considers the needs of diverse project stakeholders.
Leads project meetings and represents the organization in communications pertaining to broad aspects of engineering assignments.
Analyzes and selects principles of formal communication, effective teamwork, and various pathways to developing leadership.

Why GAI?

GAI offers skilled professionals like you an exceptional place to work, grow, lead, and achieve. Explore an array of opportunities in locations across the U.S. and join accomplished colleagues in tackling challenging projects for a range of markets. Enjoy work location and scheduling flexibility; your choice of comprehensive, personalized benefits; a range of employee wellness programs and discounts; and more. Feel good about being part of a collaborative team that’s committed to supporting the communities we serve. Join GAI and distinguish yourself in a company poised for unlimited growth.

added.title: Director of Systems Engineering R&D
added.description:
ON.energy   is setting the standard for large load interconnection. ON’s patented AI UPS™ is a medium-voltage UPS that serves as a firewall, protecting the data center from the grid, and the grid from the data center. With multiple gigawatts currently under construction, we are enabling grid-safe data centers. 
Role Objective

Lead ON.energy’s Systems Engineering team and the practices that translate product strategy, customer needs, grid requirements, and technology opportunities into complete, verifiable system solutions.  

Establish practical systems engineering governance across product architecture, requirements, interfaces, technical risk, verification, qualification, and design transfer.  

Build team capability and technical ownership for grid-scale energy storage, power conversion, UPS, and advanced power quality products from concept through field deployment.  

Team Leadership and Capability

Lead, coach, and develop Systems Engineers; define roles, ownership, capability gaps, hiring priorities, and workload balance across active product and customer programs.  

Set objectives, provide feedback, support performance management, and build the technical depth required for ON.energy’s product roadmap.  

Act as product lead engineering interface to sales, sales engineering, and project engineering  

Systems Engineering Practice and Governance

Define and improve the lifecycle for concept definition, requirements, architecture, interfaces, design reviews, technical risk, verification planning, configuration control, and design transfer.  

Establish practical templates, tools, review criteria, decision records, interface documents, and evidence expectations without creating unnecessary process burden.  

Product Architecture and Technical Direction

Guide system architectures for grid-scale energy storage, power conversion, UPS, and advanced power quality products across performance, safety, controls, protection, thermal, mechanical, cybersecurity, serviceability, and lifecycle requirements.  

Assign design authorities, resolve cross-disciplinary conflicts, and ensure structured trade studies covering performance, cost, schedule, manufacturability, supplier capability, reliability, and product risk.  

Document major technical decisions, assumptions, constraints, and rationale in a way that can be reused across future programs.  

Requirements, Interfaces, and Risk

Ensure requirements are complete, testable, traceable, and aligned with product strategy, customer commitments, regulations, grid codes, and standards.  

Oversee disciplined flow-down to subsystems, components, software, controls, verification, and release criteria.  

Establish management of electrical, mechanical, thermal, controls, communications, and operational interfaces across internal teams, suppliers, customer systems, and project applications.  

Maintain technical risk visibility across the product portfolio and drive early retirement through modeling, prototyping, supplier testing, design reviews, and root-cause investigations.  

Verification, Qualification, and Product Execution

Direct system-level verification and validation linking requirements to analysis, simulation, inspection, hardware testing, and field evidence.  

Define acceptance criteria, evidence plans, review readiness, and qualification strategy early in the product lifecycle.  

Coordinate qualification across laboratory, factory, national lab, supplier, and field environments.  

Align product intent, technical scope, schedules, and release criteria with Product Management, Program Management, discipline engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Deployment, and Service.  

Set expectations for supplier technical deliverables, reviews, interface compliance, and qualification evidence; ensure validated designs transition effectively into manufacturing, commissioning, and service.  

Stakeholder Communication

Present architecture, decisions, risk, requirements maturity, verification status, interface dependencies, and review readiness clearly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.  

Coordinate communications and engineering efforts across integrated product teams of disciplinary subject matter experts and product managers who report into other functional leaders  

Represent Systems Engineering in strategic customer, partner, supplier, standards, and technical due diligence discussions.  

Experience and Requirements

B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related field; M.S. or Ph.D. preferred.  

12+ years in complex power, energy, industrial, or electromechanical product development, including significant systems engineering responsibility and leadership of technical teams.  

Demonstrated success managing and developing Systems Engineers or multidisciplinary teams, including resource planning, hiring, performance management, and capability development.  

Proven success leading products through concept, requirements, architecture, detailed development, qualification, production release, and field deployment.  

Direct experience with grid-scale BESS, power conversion systems, uninterruptible power supplies, or adjacent power and energy hardware is strongly preferred.  

Strong command of requirements engineering, architecture, interface control, trade studies, technical risk, verification and validation, configuration management, and design review governance.  

Working knowledge of relevant grid, safety, product, and reliability standards, with the ability to resolve complex issues and communicate clearly with engineers, executives, suppliers, and customers.  

Work Environment

This role is based in Denver, Colorado or Houston, Texas, or remote with regular travel between ON.energy offices, vendor facilities, national lab partners, and customer project sites to support product development, qualification, and deployment.  
For US-based roles - What you’ll get:

Competitive salary + annual performance-based bonus eligibility
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) with company match
Paid time off and company holidays 

For Mexico-based roles - What you’ll get:

Competitive salary + annual performance bonus eligibility
Christmas Bonus (Aguinaldo): 30 days
Major medical expenses and life insurance
Paid time off and holidays (per local policy)

For all roles:

Professional development and growth opportunities
Opportunity to grow with a mission-driven team shaping the future of clean energy
Equal Opportunity: ON.energy is committed to equal employment opportunity and to maintaining a work environment free of harassment, discrimination, or retaliation.
Benefits vary by role and location and are subject to change.

Agency Notice:
  ON.energy does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or third-party recruiters. Resumes submitted without a fully executed Master Services Agreement (MSA) and a written request from an authorized member of our Talent Acquisition team will be considered the property of ON.energy. No placement fees or compensation will be paid for unsolicited candidate submissions.

added.title: Director, Analytics Engineering (2 Openings)
added.description:
Summary

Novartis has an exciting opportunity for a Director, Analytics Engineering. This role is responsible for building next-generation, AI-powered automated data pipelines and scalable data repositories that enable enterprise data science and analytics at scale. By leveraging advanced AI technologies, modern data engineering tools, and feature engineering platforms, this director creates self-service, analytics-ready datasets and enterprise feature stores that empower both expert data scientists and citizen data scientists to rapidly develop, deploy, and scale models.

This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel.

There are 2 positions available.

About The Role

Major accountabilities:

Design and implement intelligent, self-healing data pipelines that leverage AI/ML for automated data quality monitoring, anomaly detection, and remediation.
Build and maintain centralized feature stores that enable feature reusability across multiple models and use cases.
Create curated data repositories optimized for data science/AI workflows, including training datasets, evaluation datasets, and production serving layers.
Develop automated feature engineering pipelines that transform raw data into analytics-ready features with lineage tracking.
Partner with Enterprise IT to optimize analytics platform architecture for high-performance data science workloads.

added.title: Director of Data Center Field Engineering
added.description:
About the role

We are seeking an experienced Director of Data Center Field Engineering to lead a growing North America organization responsible for field delivery across enterprise, large scale, mission critical, colocation, and hyperscale Data Center environments. The Director leads through three Practice Leads and is accountable for the overall workforce, partner ecosystem, delivery performance, organizational capability, and operating health of the Data Center Field Engineering organization.
This is a leader of leaders role. The Director is expected to build the organization and operating capability required to support growth while maintaining strong execution, quality, accountability, workforce readiness, and financial discipline. The role works across Professional Services, project delivery, technical teams, resource management, partners, and business leadership to ensure the organization can support what the business is committing to deliver.

What you'll be doing

Lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable three Data Center Field Engineering Practice Leads.
Set clear expectations for leadership, workforce readiness, utilization, delivery health, quality, performance management, and accountability across the organization.
Maintain a forward looking view of demand, capacity, skills, geography, workforce risk, and future hiring or partner requirements.
Build workforce strategies that use the right mix of employees, contractors, and delivery partners based on demand, capability, cost, location, and risk.
Maintain a Data Center partner ecosystem with the capability, capacity, geographic coverage, quality, and union or non-union support required by the delivery model.
Maintain visibility to major customer engagements, delivery risks, resource issues, partner concerns, quality trends, and escalations.
Provide leadership on major delivery issues that require organizational, workforce, partner, or cross functional decisions.
Drive consistent adoption of Field Engineering delivery methods, tools, quality expectations, escalation practices, and operating processes.
Monitor utilization, workforce cost, partner spend, labor mix, productivity, capacity, and other operating measures and use them to make informed decisions.
Partner with Finance, Resource Management, PMO, RDD, Solutions, Sales, Costing and Estimating, Partner Management, and other delivery leaders.
Support major opportunities and programs by validating that proposed delivery dates, workforce models, field leadership, partner assumptions, and Field Engineering costs are practical and executable.
Build leadership depth, succession plans, and development priorities so the organization can scale without depending on a small number of individuals.
Identify recurring delivery or operating issues and drive corrective actions that improve the broader organization.
Strong understanding of Data Center infrastructure deployment and field execution in active, construction, commissioning, colocation, mission critical, or hyperscale environments.
Working knowledge of rack installation, rack build, land and level, equipment integration, structured cabling, cable management, and related physical infrastructure activities.
Working knowledge of fiber and copper installation, routing, dressing, termination, testing, patching, labeling, documentation, and acceptance expectations.
Understanding of site readiness, surveys, migrations, commissioning support, quality evidence, closeout, and customer specific execution requirements.
Experience leading organizations that use a blended workforce of internal technical leaders, field resources, contractors, and delivery partners.
Understanding of the operating requirements associated with large scale programs, rapid workforce ramp, geographic coverage, and partner-based execution.

What you have

At least 10 years of Field Engineering, Data Center infrastructure delivery, Professional Services, technical services, or related experience; 12-15+ years preferred.
At least 5 years of experience leading managers, leaders, or large distributed technical teams.
Experience leading an organization of comparable size and complexity across multiple geographies or customer programs.
Experience supporting large scale or hyperscale Data Center programs strongly preferred.
Strong workforce planning, capacity management, utilization, performance management, and organizational leadership experience.
Experience developing and managing partner-based delivery models.
Strong financial and operational acumen, including the ability to connect workforce and partner decisions to utilization, cost, productivity, and delivery performance.
Demonstrated ability to lead through other leaders rather than personally managing every project or escalation.
Ability to work effectively across technical, operational, commercial, and executive teams.
Strong communication, judgment, decision making, and organizational skills.
Ability to operate in a fast-moving environment where customer demand, resource requirements, and delivery priorities can change quickly.

What you can expect

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. In addition to offering competitive compensation plans and long-term career opportunities, we provide an attractive mix of benefit plans to contribute to your good health, future financial security, and peace of mind.

added.description:
Role Overview

Lead the strategy, engineering, modernization, and delivery of technology supporting global Fixed Income Cash Investment Management. This role partners with portfolio managers, traders, credit, risk, compliance, operations, and technology teams to build resilient, scalable platforms for liquidity management, portfolio construction, repo, trade workflows, controls, and reporting.

The successful candidate will combine Fixed Income / Cash investment domain knowledge with strong product engineering leadership to simplify the application landscape, improve real-time cash visibility, automate manual workflows, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

What You Will Do

Own the roadmap and technical direction for Fixed Income Cash Investment Management platforms across liquidity, portfolio construction, credit exposure, repo, trading, compliance, reconciliation, and reporting.
Lead modernization through cloud adoption, APIs, event-driven services, shared data products, resilient engineering, and thoughtful build-versus-buy decisions.
Automate cash-flow aggregation, forecasting, limit checks, order creation, allocations, reconciliation, exception handling, and controls.
Deliver trusted, near-real-time views of cash, positions, maturities, exposures, limits, and pending orders.
Apply AI and machine learning responsibly to decision support, alerts, anomaly detection, and workflow productivity.
Lead global engineering teams and oversee architecture, development, testing, releases, production support, resilience, and vendor delivery.
Partner with senior business and technology stakeholders to prioritize investments, manage risk, and communicate outcomes.

What We Value

Strong knowledge of modern architecture, APIs, cloud platforms, distributed systems, data engineering, cybersecurity, observability, and production resilience.
Track record of delivering automation and measurable improvements in efficiency, controls, data quality, and scalability.
Ability to influence senior stakeholders, manage strategic partners, and translate investment needs into an executable technology roadmap.

Qualifications

Bachelor's / Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
Deep understanding of portfolio management workflows and front-office investment platforms.
10+ years of progressive software engineering and technology leadership experience within Asset Management, Financial Services, Capital Markets, or related industries.
Proven track record leading large-scale engineering organizations and complex platform transformation programs.
Strong hands-on software engineering background with prior development experience in one or more modern programming languages such as Java, Python, C++, Scala, or similar enterprise technologies.
Experience designing, building, and operating enterprise-scale software platforms and distributed systems.
Experience leading globally distributed teams across software engineering, architecture, quality engineering, platform engineering, and production support functions.
Demonstrated ability to define and execute technology strategy while partnering effectively with senior business leaders.

Salary Range

$120,000 - $202,500 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Job Description

Responsible for very large or complex data center sites across multiple regions or countries and defines the group wide strategy for performance monitoring, aligning KPIs and objectives to drive global efficiency, uptime, and customer satisfaction. Oversees capacity evaluations for physical, power, cooling, and security needs to ensure readiness and operational excellence, and partners with executive leadership on long-term operational and financial targets. Drives the adoption of automation and predictive analytics, establish crisis management and process improvement standards, and promote a culture of knowledge sharing and compliance. Leads major expansion initiatives, serves as the senior executive liaison across regions, develops partnerships, and manages the full lifecycle of hardware assets—overseeing installations, maintenance, and procurement, approving large investments, and directing audits to optimize efficiency, security, and scalability.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Data Center Site Portfolio Management:

Responsibility for very large or complex sites or responsibility for multiple regions/countries.

Performance Monitoring and Analysis:

Defines the enterprise strategy for performance monitoring for all data centers in group, aligning KPIs and organizational objectives to drive efficiency, uptime, and customer satisfaction at a global scale.
Oversees the evaluation of physical, power, cooling, and security capacity, ensuring future-readiness and sustained operational excellence.
Partners with executive leadership to set and achieve multi-year operational and financial targets for the group.

Issue Management and Automation:

Drives the adoption of automation and predictive analytics for regional/country technical issues, ensuring high availability and rapid remediation of service-impacting events.
Establishes and governs standards for escalation, crisis management, root cause analysis, and continuous process improvement.
Champions a culture of knowledge sharing, ensuring best practices and lessons learned are disseminated regionally.
Leads post-incident review panels and process reform to ensure resilience and regulatory compliance.

Data Center Expansion Support:

Leads expansion initiatives including new region builds, site launches, and transformation programs; ensures delivery on time, budget, and to quality standards.
Serves as the primary senior executive liaison with cross-regional portfolio leaders, engineering, and project management teams.
Establishes partnerships (internal and external) to maximize resources, develop talent pipelines, and promote Oracle’s reputation for world-class data center operations.

Installation and Maintenance:

Oversees and integrates all facets of installation, maintenance, logistics, and inventory management across several regionally dispersed or complex data center portfolios.
Defines and enforces enterprise standards, setting expectations for efficiency, security, and scalability in procurement and lifecycle management of all hardware assets.
Approves and manages multi-million dollar investments in upgrades, capacity expansion, and critical infrastructure improvements.
Directs operational audits and risk assessments to optimize deployment and maintenance strategies.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

Provides strategic oversight on the management and execution of large-scale projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable to ensure success. Sets strategies for appropriately delegating work, setting priorities, and aligning projects with business needs. Drives the strategic planning process across teams, providing guidance on resources or timelines in anticipation of changes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

Sets a strategic direction for collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of expectations and strategic objectives. Drives a culture of teamwork, empowering teams to build and maintain partnerships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to contribute to organizational success. Promotes a culture of transparency and inclusivity where all voices are valued and respected.

Problem Solving:

Develops and implements strategies for specialized, advanced problem-solving efforts across the organization, serving as an escalation point for highly complex operational and/or technical issues. Oversees teams leveraging innovative techniques to address significant ambiguous issues, identify root causes, and prevent recurrence, reviewing solutions as needed.

Continuous Learning:

Champions continuous learning to maintain cutting-edge skills and influence organizational best practices. Inspires teams to build and maintain expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards to help position the organization as an industry leader. Contributes to the organization's strategy for learning and development, influencing leadership to foster learning opportunities for the team.

Continuous Improvement:

Drives a culture of continuous improvement that sets a standard for efficient and effective processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization. Oversees work to implement large-scale approaches and methods for continued improvement, ensuring changes align with organizational goals. Sets the strategic direction, prioritizes, and approves the roadmap of improvement initiatives to maximize return on investments.

Performance and Development:

Drives and ensures consistent application of performance management strategies, systems, processes, and guidelines across the organization. Creates an organizational culture of career development that encourages proactively identifying and pursuing career development opportunities, and guiding leaders to support their team's growth. Drives consistency in the application of talent development procedures and socializes performance expectations across the organization. Partners with HR and executive leadership to envision and execute a talent management strategy, balancing budget and talent resources.

added.title: Executive Director, Semantic and Knowledge Engineering
added.description:
Summary

Reporting to the VP, Applied AI, Data Science, and Commercial Intelligence, the Executive Director, Semantic and Knowledge Engineering leads the strategy, architecture, and implementation of the enterprise semantic layer and knowledge engineering capabilities that power NovaOS. This role is responsible for creating a trusted, reusable knowledge foundation that connects data, business concepts, ontologies, taxonomies, and AI agents to enable consistent reasoning, interoperability, and scalable enterprise intelligence.

The ideal location for this role is East Hanover but remote work may be possible (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. If associate is remote, all home office expenses and any travel/lodging to specific East Hanover for periodic live meetings will be at the employee’s expense. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 10% travel.

About The Role

Key Responsibilities:

Define and execute the enterprise strategy for semantic technologies, knowledge engineering, and knowledge graph capabilities.
Lead the development and governance of enterprise ontologies, taxonomies, business vocabularies, and semantic models that establish a shared understanding across the organization.
Design and implement the enterprise semantic layer that enables trusted AI, consistent analytics, interoperability, and reusable business knowledge.
Partner with Applied AI, Data Science, Product Management, Engineering, and Business teams to embed semantic capabilities into NovaOS products and AI solutions.
Establish governance, metadata management, knowledge lifecycle processes, and quality standards for enterprise knowledge assets.
Drive innovation in knowledge graphs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, reasoning engines, and AI-enabled knowledge management.
Build and lead a high-performing team of semantic engineers, ontology specialists, and knowledge engineers while fostering technical excellence and innovation.

added.description:
Description

Amazon Traffic Engineering builds innovative managed compute and networking solutions that empower Amazon Software Engineers to build and operate services for Amazon’s customers that are secure, highly available, and easy to scale. We identify and support the foundational infrastructure capabilities, tools, and datasets needed to support rapid global expansion of Amazon's SOA (Service Oriented Infrastructure) infrastructure, built on top of AWS technologies. Our team focuses on robust and scalable architecture patterns and engineering best practices, driving adoption of ever-evolving AWS technologies.

As a Senior Manager, you will own SDO's service oriented connectivity architecture, builder experience and regional expansion at Amazon. Our team builds and operates innovative hosted compute platforms that empower Amazon's retail engineers to build architectures for their business solutions that are secure, available, productive, and cost efficient.

This position requires direct experience leading teams and managing large deliverables to run Amazon-scale infrastructure. Your role will be multifaceted, combining strategic vision with hands-on technical expertise. You'll shape the long-term technical roadmap and set ambitious goals to drive performance improvements that benefit our customers. A key aspect of your role will be fostering a thriving engineering community, aligning organizational leaders on priorities, and optimizing resource allocation to achieve critical objectives. Your technical acumen will be put to the test as you identify architectural bottlenecks, develop proof-of-concepts, and guide senior engineers in crafting robust technical solutions. You'll be instrumental in streamlining delivery timelines through strategic engineering plans. Communication will be crucial as you keep senior leadership informed, navigate risks, and make judicious technical trade-offs to maximize customer impact. Your commitment to quality will be evident in your meticulous focus on metrics, implementation of automation to reduce operational burden, and emphasis on scalable tools to address operational challenges. This quality-first mindset will inspire and permeate throughout your team.

Our vision is to make Amazon’s Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) more manageable and developers more productive by building an ecosystem of managed abstractions that allow Amazon Retail developers to focus on their unique business logic and business operations, knowing that security, authentication, authorization, load balancing, throttling and routing “just work” and are always consistent with Amazon best practices.

Come help us create and evolve the abstractions that make developing software at Amazon even more flexible!

Own the strategy and execution for the systems, workflows, and processes that power Mercury's revenue organization, serving three teams with distinct needs: Sales, Partnerships, and Account Management.
Take business problems, design solutions, and ship them fast. We iterate in weeks, not quarters, and we'd rather put something imperfect in front of users and improve it than wait for the perfect build.
Rebuild our revenue stack AI-first, both in what we ship (automation, scoring, agent-driven workflows) and in how we build it (using AI to do the development itself).

Translate fluently between business and technical. You'll deeply understand what the revenue org is trying to accomplish, then flip gears and architect how to get there.
Lead and grow a tenured team of admins, engineers, and architects, guiding them to a high-speed, iterative operating model.
Deliver value on top of imperfect foundations, while improving those foundations over time.
Develop and leverage strong stakeholder and partner relationships to build consensus and drive impact

A track record of taking a business problem end to end: ingest it, design the solution, implement it, and do it quickly.
