Our portfolio includes creative solutions geared at helping food industry professionals compete in foodservice, retail, in-store bakery, deli, and prepared foods, among others. With more than 13,500 associates working globally in 100 countries and annual sales of $5.9 billion, Rich’s is a global leader with a focus on everything that family makes possible. Rich’s®—Infinite Possibilities. One Family.

Purpose Statement

The Senior Engineering Manager - Automation is responsible for defining and justifying long-term process, packing technology, and packaging material strategies; co-developing innovative equipment solutions with OEMs and suppliers; and leading long-term enterprise productivity transformation initiatives.

This individual will lead the development and delivery of breakthrough technology-based operational solutions, including the ideation, design, validation, and implementation of manufacturing technologies that positively transform daily operations by improving productivity and performance while ensuring operator safety and maintaining or enhancing product safety and quality.

The Senior Engineering Manager - Automation will also partner with R&D to develop new packaging materials and lead the strategy and implementation of effective packing equipment solutions. This includes driving material and equipment interaction efficiencies, developing standardized designs, and delivering cost-saving initiatives.

Key responsibilities include envisioning future possibilities, developing strategic roadmaps, and leading the research, analysis, simulation, design, programming, piloting, troubleshooting, implementation, and management of advanced packaging and packing automation solutions. These solutions include robotics, in-line quality control systems, machine vision technologies, and advanced control systems.

The ideal candidate will champion innovation across the enterprise and drive the implementation of disciplined design and technical readiness processes aligned with Reliability Engineering principles and Technology Validation protocols. This individual will also provide packaging material design feedback to improve processability, reliability, quality, and cost optimization, while identifying and implementing material cost savings through simplification and packaging/packing equipment standardization.

In addition, the Senior Engineering Manager - Automation will proactively develop enterprise-wide business cases for automation and savings initiatives and manage capital and material optimization projects from concept through vertical start-up. Responsibilities include defining engineering scope, developing technical solutions and justifications, leading project execution, managing vendors, overseeing on-site start-up activities, validating equipment and material performance, and ensuring successful achievement of all project objectives.

This role can be based at any of our manufacturing plants in the USA, with up to 50% travel.

Key Accountabilities And Outcomes

The key responsibilities and expected outcomes of this position include:

Develop innovation plans and lead the identification of breakthrough, cross-category manufacturing opportunities that can be solved through packaging design, packing and process technology, controls, automation solutions, and AI. Develop sound technical and business proposals to secure leadership support for evaluation and execution.
Lead the development of diverse, multi-category platform solutions that support material and technology requirements, business economics, and technical recommendations. Collaborate with materials suppliers, equipment manufacturers, controls providers, software vendors, and manufacturing operations partners to create and deliver innovative solutions.
Lead multiple projects and technical re-platforming programs through discovery, design, and implementation. Ensure excellence in:
Option analysis and documentation
Process flow diagrams and block diagrams
Simulations and risk assessments
Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
Reliability and quality analyses
Cost estimating and safety studies
Technical recommendations and scheduling
Prototyping and learning plans
Test planning and execution
Equipment and material testing
Troubleshooting and acceptance testing
Construction planning and start-up execution
Serve as Project Manager and/or Program Leader on complex initiatives, directly owning project scope, cost management, technical readiness, business justification, funding approvals, management reviews, project execution plans, construction activities, schedule adherence, start-up execution, and achievement of all project success criteria. Coach and develop engineering project managers to strengthen execution capabilities across the organization.
Partner with Manufacturing Operations and Packaging Development R&D leaders to deliver technology and packaging material solutions that achieve safety, quality, reliability, operability, maintainability, sustainability, and cost objectives, while supporting technology transfer and training requirements.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with packaging material suppliers, equipment manufacturers, and technology providers to identify and deliver best-in-class solutions that meet cost, quality, schedule, and technical performance objectives.
Lead, coach, train, and develop direct reports and other technical professionals across the organization.
Communicate effectively and regularly with leadership regarding project progress, risks, opportunities, and future plans.
Perform all other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Robotics Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of fifteen (15) years of demonstrated experience in packing/process engineering, packaging technology engineering, robotics, or related disciplines involving the design, improvement, or development of new packing equipment platforms and manufacturing processes.
Demonstrated experience collaborating with Packaging R&D in the development, validation, and commercialization of new packaging solutions and innovative or sustainable materials.
Demonstrated experience leading teams of engineers, OEMs, suppliers, and contractors in the development and implementation of new technologies that deliver breakthrough results.
Experience applying TPM and Lean Manufacturing methodologies to support successful vertical start-ups.
Demonstrated success transforming manufacturing operations through automation, platform modernization, standardization, and complex technical problem solving.
Proven ability to plan, organize, lead, and influence technical resources while balancing competing priorities and successfully delivering complex programs across multiple manufacturing facilities and product categories.
Self-motivated and capable of working independently while driving solutions and results.
Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions, divisions, and organizational levels.

added.title: DevOps Sr. Automation Engineering Manager – AAP Lifecycle Automation & Platform Engineering
added.description:
Job Descriptions:

About Infinite:

Infinite is a global leader in digital engineering and IT services, with over 20 years of experience driving digital transformation. We partner with leading Fortune 1000 companies to deliver innovative, scalable technology solutions that accelerate business outcomes.
With deep expertise in telecommunications, healthcare, banking, and finance, Infinite helps organizations optimize and modernize their technology landscapes to achieve long-term growth and efficiency.

DevOps Sr. Automation Engineering Manager – AAP Lifecycle Automation & Platform Engineering

Synopsis

Candidates in this role are “Builder-Architects” responsible for owning the design, delivery, and scaling of enterprise lifecycle automation across secure production environments. This role requires blending deep, hands-on Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) lifecycle engineering with the Agile sprint leadership needed to run a delivery-focused automation team, driving rapid, automated CVE remediation and platform upgrades across both RHEL virtual machine estates and containerized production services, spanning on-premises data centers and Microsoft Azure.
DevOps Sr. Automation Engineering Manager, AAP Lifecycle & Hybrid Platform Automation
Executive Summary

The mission for the DevOps Sr. Automation Engineering Manager of AAP Lifecycle Automation is twofold:

Internally: architect, build, and scale the Ansible Automation Platform (AAP/AWX) estate and its connected toolchain, while leading Agile sprint teams through Jira-managed backlogs to deliver patching, CVE remediation, and lifecycle upgrades on schedule.
Externally: act as the trusted automation advisor to the client on the Production Lifecycle Automation Solution, with a clear focus on the speed of security vulnerability remediation. Guide the critical implementation of Ansible Automation Platform and the transition from legacy Jenkins-based pipelines to AAP-controlled, policy-governed automation across the production environment of VM and container workloads, on-premises and in Microsoft Azure.

Strategic Leadership & Design

Architecture & Development: own the roadmap and execution plan for implementing AAP and migrating lifecycle automation from Jenkins to Ansible Automation Platform (AAP/AWX), including job templates, workflow templates, execution environments, and RBAC design.
Agile Delivery Leadership: run Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, retrospectives) and manage the team's Jira board, ensuring lifecycle, patching, and CVE remediation work is scoped, sequenced, and delivered sprint over sprint.
Hybrid Lifecycle Blueprints: design reference architectures that unify RHEL virtual machine patch/upgrade lifecycles with stateless container service lifecycles across on-premises and Microsoft Azure environments, ensuring consistent controls across both.
Governance & Compliance: align automation design with secure environment, audit, and change-control requirements, and drive the implementation of approval gates and workflows, secure credential handling, and change evidence.

Technical Experience

Ansible Automation Platform / Lifecycle Management (5–10 years): design, deploy, and operate Ansible Automation Platform / AWX at scale, including controller/hub configuration, execution environments, job scheduling, and workflow orchestration for patching, CVE remediation, and version upgrades.
Integrated Toolchain Control: use AAP as the control plane to orchestrate Azure Key Vault (secrets/credential management), Git (source and playbook version control), JFrog Artifactory (artifact and image repository), Kubernetes, and ArgoCD (GitOps continuous delivery) for production workloads.
Container & VM Lifecycle: Manage lifecycle automation across both stateless container services (Docker/Podman image builds, promotion, and deployment) and traditional RHEL VM application workloads, applying consistent patch, CVE, and upgrade practices to each.
Microsoft Azure Platform Automation: extend AAP-driven lifecycle management into Microsoft Azure, covering Azure VM (IaaS) patch and upgrade automation via the Ansible azure_rm collection, and stateless container lifecycle management on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Azure Container Apps. Hands-on use of Azure automation languages and tooling, including Bicep and ARM (JSON) templates for infrastructure-as-code, PowerShell (Az module) and Azure CLI (Bash) for scripting, Python (Azure SDK) for custom automation, and YAML for Ansible playbooks and pipeline definitions.
Scrum / Jira Sprint Leadership (5–10 years): lead cross-functional engineering teams through Agile/Scrum delivery cycles, using Jira to plan, track, and report on lifecycle automation epics, stories, and sprint velocity.
Architecture & Scaling: architect the growth of AAP and its connected platforms (Vault, Git, JFrog, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, and Microsoft Azure) to support increasing workload volume, new business units, and additional bank/government client environments.
CI/CD & Automation Pipelines: build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that hand off from development through pre-production to production and ongoing lifecycle teams, with Ansible as the execution layer.

Organizational Management

Team Leadership: lead engineering and automation teams responsible for lifecycle delivery across dev, pre-prod, and production/lifecycle organizations.
Workforce Transformation: upskill traditional Jenkins-focused engineers into AAP-centric, GitOps-driven automation practitioners.
Delivery Governance: track sprint throughput, patch/CVE SLA adherence, and platform upgrade cadence, reporting status and risk to leadership and client stakeholders.

Key Qualifications

Experience: 10+ years in DevOps/infrastructure engineering leadership, including 5–10 years of hands-on AAP (Ansible Automation Platform) lifecycle management and 5–10 years of Scrum/Jira sprint leadership, ideally within highly secure or bank/government environments.

Technical Breadth:

Deep hands-on expertise with Ansible Automation Platform / AWX, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault, Git, JFrog Artifactory, Kubernetes, and ArgoCD.
Proven experience with Docker/Podman container image workloads and stateless container service lifecycle management.
Strong background in RHEL VM lifecycle: patching, rapid CVE remediation, and version upgrades at enterprise scale.
Experience migrating legacy Jenkins pipelines to modern AAP-controlled automation.
Hands-on Microsoft Azure experience automating both Azure VM (IaaS) and stateless container (AKS/Azure Container Apps) lifecycles, using Bicep, ARM (JSON) templates, PowerShell (Az module), Azure CLI, Python (Azure SDK), and the Ansible azure_rm collection.
Client/Stakeholder Presence: demonstrated ability to present lifecycle automation strategy and delivery status to bank and government client stakeholders and internal leadership.
Leadership: demonstrated success architecting and scaling automation platforms while leading Agile delivery teams in regulated, security-sensitive environments.

added.title: Director of Engineering, Platform
added.description:
Director of Engineering, Platform

About the Client:

My client is a profitable home equity lender backed by a multi-billion dollar alternative asset manager. They built their lending platform themselves and own the whole loan lifecycle in house, from application through underwriting, closing documents, money movement and servicing. That is why they can close a home equity line in as little as one day while the rest of the industry takes weeks. They originate hundreds of millions a month and are scaling toward a billion, serving hundreds of lender partners and tens of thousands of loan officers. They also run their platform white-labelled under other lenders' brands, so they are part lender and part embedded finance business.

The Role:

You would lead their platform organization: the systems the product runs on, and the tooling their engineers ship through. Where their Director of Engineering, Product owns what ships, you own what it ships on, and the speed and safety with which it ships.

Engineering there is still taking shape. One function, platform and infrastructure, has a lead and a defined team today. The others do not. Your first job is to bring structure to the functions that need it, put the right leads in place, and set the standard for how they build. Ten people on the platform team today, five full-time and the rest on contract, spread across the US and South America, and they are in midst of scaling in a big way!

What you would own:

Core, and where they need you strongest:
Platform and infrastructure. The AWS estate, account structure, environment strategy, infrastructure as code and the direction of their compute.
Reliability and SRE. Observability that surfaces a problem before a partner reports it, on-call and incident practice where the review changes the system rather than the ticket, and service level objectives tied to what the business actually needs.
Developer experience and delivery. The path from commit to production, and environments engineers can trust. Product engineering is your customer and their velocity is your measure.

Also yours, with room to shape how:
Quality engineering. Test automation and frameworks that let every team test its own work.
The AI engineering platform. They build AI-first. You would set the direction on harnesses, guardrails and evaluation tooling. In regulated lending the boundary is firm: the deterministic result is the source of truth, a human makes the loan decision, and the agent path never writes or gates it.

Partnered, not yours to absorb: security and GRC report separately, architecture owns cross-cutting design, and corporate IT runs endpoints and identity.

The work in front of you:

The platform works and the business is growing on it, but it was built for a fraction of the volume it now carries.

Ahead of you:
Tenant isolation for enterprise partners, moving from switch-based partitioning to real separation.
A shift from function-per-endpoint serverless toward containerized services on EKS with durable execution on money-path workflows.
Synchronous request handling moving to event-driven processing with proper queueing and failure handling. And SOC 2 Type 2 supported by real technical controls.

All of it happens while origination volume grows, not during a pause. That constraint is the job.

What they are looking for:

Around seven years in engineering, with three to five years leading engineers
Real depth in at least two of: platform and infrastructure, reliability and SRE, or DevOps and delivery
Cloud-native and deep in AWS, with a considered position on infrastructure as code, containers and durable execution. Kubernetes or EKS in production
You have built structure where there was none: installed leads, set standards, and made delivery predictable
Technical enough to read a design doc and a diff and form your own opinion. Writing production code is not the job, but you have not lost the ability
You can share ownership. CI/CD, observability, incident practice and SOC 2 are collaborations between you, the VP of Engineering and your peer on the product side. That is deliberate, and it suits people who would rather build something together than draw a boundary around it

Nice to have:

Regulated financial services: lending, mortgage, home equity or payments, where correctness, auditability and security are first-class rather than overhead
Multi-tenant platforms where enterprise customers required real isolation
SOC 2 or equivalent owned from the engineering side
Hands-on experience with agentic development tooling in production
Leading distributed and contract teams across time zones

If this is you, or you know someone it fits, let's get in touch!

About The Role

Virtium is seeking a Senior VP, Technology to help define the next chapter of our technology strategy as we expand from our strong foundation in industrial memory and storage into broader embedded computing, Edge AI, connectivity, and integrated system-level solutions.

This is a highly visible executive role for a senior technology leader who can combine deep technical credibility, customer insight, product vision, and practical business judgment. The Senior VP, Technology will partner directly with the CTO, executive leadership, customers, technology partners, and internal teams to shape where Virtium invests, differentiates, and grows.

About Virtium

Virtium is a Rancho Santa Margarita, California–based designer and manufacturer of high-reliability industrial embedded solutions for customers whose systems must operate consistently in demanding, long-life environments. For more than 25 years, Virtium has supported global OEMs with industrial-grade SSDs, DRAM memory modules, compute and system-on-module solutions, AI accelerator modules, connectivity modules, and supporting software.

Our solutions are used in applications across networking and telecommunications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, medical, transportation, rugged computing, Industrial IoT, and other mission-critical embedded markets where reliability, lifecycle stability, qualification, and supply continuity matter.

Why This Role Matters

Virtium’s customers are navigating increasing complexity across embedded computing, Edge AI workloads, memory and storage requirements, semiconductor transitions, security expectations, and long product lifecycles. The Senior VP, Technology will help identify where customer requirements, emerging technologies, supplier roadmaps, and market opportunities intersect—and translate those insights into differentiated solutions, strategic partnerships, and scalable product opportunities.

The right leader will have the chance to influence Virtium’s technology direction at a meaningful stage of growth, with direct access to executive decision-making and a clear connection between strategy, customer need, product development, and market impact.

What You’ll Lead

Reporting to the CTO, the Senior VP, Technology will serve as Virtium’s senior technology strategist and trusted technical voice with customers, suppliers, partners, and internal teams. This leader will guide through technical credibility, strategic judgment, collaboration, and cross-functional influence while partnering closely with engineering leadership responsible for development execution.

Key Areas of Impact

Customer and Market Strategy: Build trusted-advisor relationships with strategic OEM customers, understand their embedded system architecture and future requirements, and identify where Virtium can create differentiated technical and commercial value.
Technology and Product Roadmap: Define and maintain Virtium’s long-term roadmap across industrial SSDs, DRAM memory, compute/SOM platforms, AI accelerator modules, connectivity modules, and related software-enabled solutions.
Technology Ecosystem Leadership: Develop strategic relationships with semiconductor manufacturers, processor and controller suppliers, memory and NAND partners, AI accelerator providers, connectivity partners, and other key technology ecosystem partners.
Architecture and Technical Direction: Guide major platform, architecture, and technology decisions across hardware, firmware, software, edge workload performance, system integration, thermal and power constraints, reliability, qualification, validation, and lifecycle requirements.
Executive Alignment and Growth: Align executive, commercial, product, engineering, operations, and supply chain teams around focused technology priorities that support customer value, differentiation, revenue growth, manufacturability, and time to market.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Executive-level technology leader with 15+ years of relevant experience in embedded systems, edge computing, memory, storage, semiconductors, computing hardware, connectivity, industrial hardware, or complex hardware/software platforms.
Strong customer-facing Senior VP, Technology, VP Engineering, Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow, or senior technology leadership background with credibility across OEM customers, engineering teams, suppliers, and executive stakeholders.
Deep understanding of how to balance innovation with reliability, lifecycle stability, manufacturability, qualification, security, performance, and supply continuity in demanding embedded or mission-critical environments.
Proven ability to translate customer and market insight into technology roadmaps, scalable product opportunities, strategic partnerships, and practical execution priorities.
Comfortable operating in a hands-on, collaborative, growth-oriented environment where influence, clarity, judgment, and customer proximity matter.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related technical discipline

Job Summary

This position will lead the team responsible for the data platforms and pipelines that power reporting, analytics, operational decision making, and future AI capabilities across the company.

This is a technical leadership role focused on setting direction, developing the team, and making sure our data platform continues to evolve with the needs of the business. added.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About The Role

Skydio is seeking an experienced Solutions Engineering leader to join our team as Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering for the SLED Top 1200. The Top 1200 is the band of agencies immediately below Majors, and it is where the Drone as First Responder motion moves from bespoke to repeatable, so the work rewards a leader who can build patterns and hold a team to them. The segment runs as one national team today, and depending on growth it may later split into East and West regions; building the team so that split is clean when it comes is part of the job.

This is a remote role. Travel of approximately 30% is required to support customer engagements, field activities, deployments, team onsites, and company events.

This role reports to the Director, Solutions Engineering – SLED.

About The Team

The SLED Solutions Engineering team is the technical arm of Skydio's state and local go-to-market motion. We sit between the agency and the product: turning operational problems into program designs, proving capability in the field, and making sure Skydio's products are used, integrated, and flown at scale.

The team is measured on technical win rate, trial and proof of concept outcomes, program expansion, site assessment quality, and the requirements we push back into the product organization.

Solutions Engineers are critical members of the Skydio organization and work closely with Key Account Leaders, Engineering, and Product to support deal progression, customer confidence, successful deployments, and the long-term success of Public Safety sUAS programs.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Lead the team

Hire, onboard, coach, and retain your team, with clear ownership and coverage across the territories in your segment, and develop people beyond the seat they are in.
Set the bar for technical quality — demos, trial plans, site assessments, and customer-facing documentation that hold up in front of a chief, a sheriff, or a city council.
Own capacity across your segment. Decide where Solutions Engineering time goes, say no when it needs to be said, and make the tradeoffs visible to leadership.

Drive technical wins

Own the technical win across the Top 1200 nationally, pairing one Solutions Engineer to each Key Account Leader.
Serve as the senior technical escalation point on critical pursuits, deployments, and customer issues. Jump in and work the problem yourself, and be in the field when it matters.
Partner with Sales leadership on pipeline, forecast, and account planning, and on the land-and-expand motion that turns a first dock into a citywide program.

Own the Top 1200 problem set

Turn what works in Majors into something repeatable at volume. Demo standards, site assessment quality, and trial design are yours to systematize, and to structure so the segment can split regionally without relearning the motion.
Own site assessment quality as a performance measure. Solutions Engineers are the DRI for verifying a dock location before deployment, and the quality of the resulting installation reflects on the team.
Hold the bar on proofs of concept: structured deployments tied to an active opportunity with measurable operational value, not casual evaluations.
Guide integration and airspace strategy — CAD and dispatch, video and evidence management, streaming platforms, BVLOS approvals, waivers, COAs, and docked operations.
Maintain command of the public sector procurement path, including cooperative contracts, grant funded programs, and public sector buying cycles.

Represent the customer inside Skydio

Be the aggregated voice of the customer to Product and Engineering. Turn field observations into prioritized, defensible requirements rather than a list of one-off asks.
Build the enablement content, reference architectures, and reusable technical assets that let the team scale, and maintain first-hand product knowledge through frequent hands-on use.

What Makes You a Good Fit

5+ years of relevant technical experience, including time in a customer-facing technical role (solutions engineering, field engineering, or applications engineering).
1+ years leading a technical team, formally or as a technical lead with hiring and mentorship responsibility. First-time managers with a demonstrated record of leading and developing people will be considered.
Strong understanding of drone technology, Public Safety sUAS operations, and regulatory compliance, including Drone as First Responder concepts of operation and dock based remote operations.
Working knowledge of Public Safety technologies, including CAD, VMS, and related software platforms, and the ability to lead integration discussions.
A track record of hiring, onboarding, and developing technical people, and of keeping them.
Comfort operating inside a Sales organization, including owning a quota, deal strategy, and the judgment to know when to commit technical resources and when to decline.
Excellent written and verbal communication. You can brief an operator, a program manager, and a senior executive without changing the facts.
Lead by example. Willing to do whatever is needed to get a customer situation resolved.

Nice to Have

Prior public safety service as a sworn officer, firefighter, or agency UAS program lead.
Experience standing up a Drone as First Responder program from waiver through go-live, and with dock-based, remote, and BVLOS operations at scale.
Familiarity with grant funding pathways and cooperative purchasing vehicles used by state and local agencies.
Working knowledge of Salesforce, Palantir, Databricks, or equivalents.
Track record of building and scaling a technical team through a period of rapid growth.

About Flow

Flow is the systems engineering platform for the world's best hardware teams. Companies like Rivian run their programs on Flow, keeping requirements, interfaces, tests, and design decisions connected in one live system instead of scattered across documents and legacy tools. We're growing fast, backed by Sequoia, and selling into an industry that is actively rethinking how engineering work gets done.

The role

Our technical win is consultative. In mid-market and enterprise deals, our SEs run a structured two-week evaluation where they don't just prove the product works. They sit with systems engineers and chief engineers and help them redesign how their organization does engineering to move faster. When we win, it's because we’ve demonstrated to the customer a new way of working, not because we checked more feature boxes.

Right now we have a small SE team and no playbook. Deals get won, but they're won on individual effort rather than a system.

Your job is to build that machine while running deals inside it. You'll carry evaluations yourself from day one, codify what already works on the team into a playbook anyone strong can run, and then hire and ramp the team that runs it. We plan to grow from to 10+ across regions in the next 12 months. The hiring bar, the ramp program, and the eval framework are yours to design and own.

You'll report to the Head of Sales and work as a peer to our AE team. You'll also help design the handoff from technical win to deployment as we build out post-sales.

What you'll own in year one

Personally run technical evaluations on our most important deals
Codify the SE playbook: trial plans, workshop formats, demo environments, competitive positioning against legacy requirements tools
Define the SE hiring profile and hire SEs
Build onboarding and certification so a new SE is running evals independently within their first quarter
Design the technical-win-to-deployment handoff with the Head of Sales

Who does well here

You've led a solutions engineering or solutions architecture team of roughly 4 to 10 people, and you were still in deals while you led it. If you haven't personally run an enterprise evaluation in the last year, this probably isn't the right fit.
You built the systems, you didn't inherit them. You can show us an onboarding program, eval framework, or demo environment you created from nothing, ideally at a company generating eight figures of ARR
You've hired SEs against a bar you defined, and you can talk honestly about the ones you got wrong.

At Deckers Brands, Together, Every Step is a promise kept that every employee can bring their authentic self, is valued and supported, as a whole person, at work and beyond. Together, Every Step is how we continue to deliver exceptional business results, experience an amazing place to work, and have a positive impact on the communities and world around us.

Job Title:
Director, Platform Architecture

Reports to:
Chief Digital & Data Officer

Location:
United States (Remote)

Interested applicants must reside in one of the following approved states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Indiana, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Washington

The Role

As the Director, Platform Architecture, you will define and scale Deckers’ modern data and analytics platform architecture, ensuring it is secure, scalable, governed, and optimized for performance and cost. You’ll establish foundational architectural frameworks, technology standards, and best practices for our cloud-native platform, with AWS as the core environment. Collaborating with data architects, platform and DevOps engineering teams, product leaders, and governance specialists, you’ll enable analytics, AI, and domain-driven data products across the enterprise through reusable platform services, robust security and access controls, and clear operational standards.

We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.

Your Impact

Support the development of the enterprise data platform strategy aligned with business objectives and digital transformation initiatives
Define and maintain the architectural blueprint and reference architecture for the cloud-native data platform using AWS as the core environment
Establish principles and patterns for platform scalability, reliability, security, observability, and cost optimization across platform services and shared capabilities
Design and maintain standards for platform architecture layers including infrastructure, networking, identity and access management, audit logging, metadata management, access control, and observability
Partner with domain architects and engineering teams to ensure shared platform services are reusable, modular, and governed, and that domain teams can self-serve effectively
Guide the adoption of platform services and tools that enable data mesh, pub-sub models, event-driven architectures, and self-serve data product delivery
Lead evaluation and selection of core platform technologies and services, ensuring they meet business needs for analytics, real-time streaming, governance, and machine learning enablement
Promote architectural patterns that enable resilience, scalability, cost efficiency, and rapid delivery, including standards for automation, environment management, and operational readiness
Partner with Data Governance, Security, and Compliance teams to embed privacy, security, and audit-readiness into platform architecture and delivery practices
Define standards for metadata capture, lineage tracking, data quality measurement, and access management across platform services and tooling
Provide architectural leadership and mentorship to platform engineers, DevOps teams, and data engineering teams, including design reviews and technical guidance
Collaborate with Program Delivery, Product Management, and architecture peers to align roadmaps, sequencing, and execution plans across multiple teams
Influence platform design decisions across the organization and drive alignment to enterprise goals through standards, reference implementations, and review processes
Support vendor evaluations, licensing decisions, and long-term technology investments for the platform ecosystem, including total cost of ownership considerations

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field; Master’s degree preferred
AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or equivalent certifications are highly preferred
10 to 15 years of experience in platform architecture, data architecture, or enterprise systems design
5 or more years of leadership experience building or scaling cloud-native data platforms, ideally on AWS
Experience supporting modern data architectures including lakehouse models, real-time streaming, and domain-oriented data products
Experience in the retail, consumer products, or e-commerce industry is preferred but not required
Deep expertise in AWS cloud services related to data storage, compute, networking, security, and auditability, including services such as S3, Redshift, Glue, Lake Formation, EMR, Kinesis, IAM, VPC, and CloudTrail
Knowledge of distributed computing frameworks, modern file formats and open table standards including Parquet and Iceberg
Familiarity with governance, cataloging, lineage, and privacy frameworks and regulations including GDPR and CCPA
Deep understanding of modern cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, and data platform technologies
Strong leadership skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence without direct authority
Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities in complex, fast-paced environments
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Ability to foster innovation, drive continuous improvement, and create scalable technical frameworks
Comfortable working in a global, matrixed organization with a proactive, results-driven approach

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

Elevate RFPs and security assessments. Build a scalable, high-quality function for RFPs, security questionnaires, and technical/security assessments — improving accuracy, consistency, and turnaround, and building reusable content that raises win rates.
Enable and scale the channel. Technically enable partners — training, certification, demo readiness, and deal support — so they can independently represent and implement our product.
Partner with Enablement. Work with Sales Enablement to design and deliver technical training, certification, demo standards, and competitive playbooks that keep the team and the wider revenue org sharp.
Be the voice of the customer to Product. Capture field and technical feedback and channel it to Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.
Operate as a revenue leader. Contribute to forecasting, capacity planning, and go-to-market strategy with the CRO and revenue leadership team, and define the metrics and processes that make the function measurable and scalable.

What will you bring?

We care far more about your track record than your tenure. The bar is a leader who has built and run a world-class technical team serving technical customers with a technical product.
A demonstrated track record of building and leading a world-class Solutions/Sales Engineering team — you've raised the technical bar of an organization, not just managed headcount.
Experience selling and supporting a genuinely technical product to technical buyers and evaluators (engineers, security teams, architects). Cybersecurity or security/GRC experience is strongly preferred; adjacent deeply-technical domains considered.
Proven experience as a manager of managers leading distributed or global teams across multiple time zones.
Ownership of the technical experience across the customer journey — from the technical win in new business through post-sales technical support and cross-sell.
A hands-on disposition — you're credible and willing in the room, able to step into and lead a high-stakes customer call yourself.
A track record of building or scaling RFP / security assessment functions and lifting win rates through repeatable process and reusable content.
Experience technically enabling channel / partner ecosystems so partners can represent and implement the product independently.
A strong partnership orientation — you've worked shoulder-to-shoulder with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Enablement.
Excellent executive communication skills; equally credible with C-level buyers and hands-on technical evaluators.
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth, remote-first environment.

What's in it for you?

WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard

Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave
Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance

Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work

added.description:
Founding Head of Engineering / Technical Cofounder — AI Agents & Infrastructure

Nivalto • Stealth

Location:
Remote-first — San Francisco Bay Area candidates (only)

CEO / Founder
Stage:
Pre-Seed → Seed
Seniority:
Technical Cofounder / Founding Engineering Leadership

Time Commitment:
Fractional, approximately 10–12 hours/week during pre-seed, with expected conversion to full-time following financing.

Post-Seed Compensation:
Expected base salary of $220K–$300K
, subject to financing, board approval, candidate experience, and company compensation policies. This role also includes significant technical-cofounder equity.

Equity:
Target technical-cofounder equity of approximately 5%–10% on a fully diluted basis at the time of grant
, subject to vesting, board approval, future financing dilution, and final terms. The final grant will reflect the candidate’s pre-seed contribution, timing of full-time conversion, and scope of technical ownership.

About Nivalto

Nivalto is building infrastructure for the emerging agentic economy, focused on regulated enterprise environments where AI agents must securely interact across organizations, systems, workflows, and financial transactions.

As agents become capable of consequential actions, enterprises need infrastructure governing:

identity • authority • policy • execution • evidence • interoperability • human control

Nivalto is developing a protocol-first platform to make these interactions secure, governable, interoperable, and enterprise-ready. Our public standards work includes AgentROA (Route of Authority)
, focused on governed authority for AI-agent workflows. Other proprietary architecture remains confidential.

The Role

This is not a conventional Head of Engineering position.

You will join Nivalto as its technical cofounder and senior engineering owner, partnering directly with the Founder to turn the company’s vision into production infrastructure.

You will operate as:

Technical Cofounder + Head of Engineering + Principal Engineer + Architect

Most importantly:

You will build.

This is a player-coach role with a strong emphasis on player. You will personally write production code, design core services and APIs, solve difficult infrastructure problems, review security-sensitive implementation, build reference systems and tests, participate in deployment, and make foundational architecture decisions.

You will later recruit and lead the initial engineering organization, but your authority should come first from deep technical understanding and execution.

The Opportunity

You will help build a new infrastructure category around governed AI agents and trusted agent interaction across distributed systems, identity and authorization, policy enforcement, cryptography, evidence and provenance, high-integrity transactions, cloud infrastructure, enterprise interoperability, and open standards.

You will take systems through the complete lifecycle:

concept → architecture → specification → implementation → testing → deployment → enterprise integration → production operation

What You Will Build

Agent Governance, Identity & Authorization

Build production infrastructure governing how AI agents establish identity and authority, interact with enterprise systems, execute permitted actions, and produce verifiable evidence. Implement and help evolve Nivalto’s publicly available AgentROA specification and enterprise integration patterns.

High-Integrity Execution & Evidence

Build systems for scoped capabilities, policy evaluation, human approvals, execution boundaries, revocation, fail-safe behavior, transaction integrity, idempotency, reconciliation, and auditability.

Enterprise Platform & Developer Infrastructure

Own foundational APIs and services, distributed architecture, cryptographic signing and verification, secure service communication, key and secrets management, observability, tenant isolation, reliability, and production operations. Build APIs, SDKs, adapters, reference implementations, test harnesses, and conformance tooling.

Core Responsibilities

Hands-On Engineering

Personally design, implement, test, review, deploy, and troubleshoot production infrastructure. Early contribution will be measured primarily through:

architecture + code + technical judgment + systems shipped

Architecture, Security & Strategy

Own major decisions across APIs, distributed architecture, security boundaries, deployment topology, scalability, interoperability, and build-versus-buy choices. Own Nivalto’s initial security architecture, including threat modeling, authorization, cryptography, key management, secure communication, tamper-evident evidence, and incident architecture.

Engineering Leadership

Establish standards for code quality, testing, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, observability, SLOs, deployment, incident response, and production readiness. Following financing, recruit the initial engineering team while remaining deeply involved in architecture and implementation.

Fundraising, Standards & Customers

Participate in technical investor diligence and early customer and partner architecture discussions. Help translate standards work into production infrastructure, reference implementations, interoperability tests, and developer guidance.

Required Qualifications

Principal-Level Engineering Capability

10+ years building production software systems.
Significant Staff, Principal, Distinguished, Architect, CTO, Head of Engineering, or comparable experience.
Demonstrated ability to personally architect and build complex 0→1 infrastructure through production.
Comfortable operating simultaneously as senior engineer and engineering leader.
Strong judgment around complexity, reliability, security, and long-term architecture.
Early-stage or founding-company experience strongly preferred.

Technical Depth

Deep practical experience across several of:
backend/distributed systems, APIs, workflow systems, state machines, resilience, and observability;
PKI, cryptographic signing, OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, authorization systems, policy engines, Zero Trust, HSM/KMS, and secrets management;
AWS, GCP, or Azure; containers/Kubernetes; infrastructure-as-code; CI/CD; SRE and multi-tenant SaaS.

Exceptional Technical Communication

Able to communicate complex systems through architecture documents, RFCs, threat models, developer documentation, and investor diligence.

Highly Valued Experience

Experience with AI-agent infrastructure, identity/authorization, security gateways, policy engines, payments or treasury infrastructure, transaction orchestration, evidence/provenance systems, regulated software, or developer platforms is especially relevant.
Standards experience with IETF, CNCF, W3C, OpenTelemetry, SPIFFE/SPIRE, OAuth, OpenID, or similar communities is a plus.

Education

BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent technical experience. Advanced degrees are welcome; exceptional engineering experience may outweigh formal credentials.

Engagement & Conversion

Pre-Seed

Fractional commitment of approximately 10–12 hours per week. You will operate as Nivalto’s technical cofounder and own foundational architecture and engineering work. This is not an advisory position. You will personally build.

Post-Seed

Following financing, the role is expected to convert to full-time.

Base Salary:
$200K–$230K

Performance Incentive:
Up to 10–15%

Equity:
Target approximately 5%–7% total ownership at full-time conversion, subject to board approval, vesting, dilution, and final terms.

Who This Role Is Not For

This is probably not the right role if you primarily want to manage managers, delegate implementation immediately, inherit an established engineering organization, operate mainly through meetings, or move away from hands-on engineering.

Who This Role Is For

This role may be a strong fit if your ideal opportunity sounds like:

“I want to join at the beginning, own the technology with the founder, build the hardest parts myself, establish the engineering foundation, help raise capital, and build the engineering organization around what works.”

You should enjoy moving continuously between:

strategy → whiteboard → architecture → code → production → customer → investor

Apply

Send your LinkedIn profile or CV and a short note describing one or two complex infrastructure systems you personally helped architect and build to:
hr@nivalto.com

Subject:
Founding Head of Engineering / Technical Cofounder
Please be specific about what you personally designed and implemented and the production, reliability, security, or scale requirements involved.

Work Authorization:
Candidates must be U.S. citizens or otherwise currently authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future. As a pre-seed, bootstrapped startup offering this role on a fractional basis, Nivalto is unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position.

Equal Opportunity & Confidentiality:
Nivalto is an equal opportunity employer. Nivalto is currently operating in stealth. Proprietary architecture and other confidential information are disclosed selectively and may require an NDA.

Publicly disclosed standards work, including AgentROA
, may be discussed openly. Nivalto’s proprietary implementations and other intellectual property remain confidential.

added.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZero™ platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by IT Ops/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox" security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn-it-alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

As a remote first company, we require minimum 25Mbps consumer grade broadband connection.

What You'll Do

You will lead Client Platform — the team responsible for the software that lives in customer environments and makes NodeZero's autonomous pentests possible. Client Platform owns two sub-teams: Image Build & Release (the factory that produces and signs the NodeZero runner container image) and OTA Services (the system that keeps runners current across thousands of customer environments). Every pentest NodeZero runs depends on this team's work being reliable, secure, and fast.

Team Building & Culture: Build, mentor, and grow Client Platform to ~10 engineers across Image Build & Release and OTA Services. You will directly manage the Engineering Managers of both sub-teams and set the technical and cultural direction for the full org. Establish engineering norms and a culture of ownership for a team whose software runs in environments you cannot control.
Image Build & Release: Lead end-to-end CI/CD workflows to create, sign, and reliably publish the NodeZero runner container image. Own software supply chain security: reproducible builds, image signing, SBOM generation, and vulnerability scanning in CI.
OTA Services: Architect and operate the over-the-air update delivery system that keeps NodeZero runners current across thousands of customer environments — reliably, securely, and without requiring manual customer IT intervention.
Security Research Partnership: Collaborate closely with Security Research to ensure the runner seamlessly executes new autonomous pentest capabilities as they ship.
Act as a Product Owner: Partner with product managers, security researchers, and customer success to manage the client-side roadmap.

What You'll Bring

Platform Leadership & Architecture

Demonstrated expertise leading teams that design, build, and operate containerized software (Docker, VM images) deployed into on-premise or customer-managed environments.
Experience implementing robust software supply chain practices — secure builds, image signing (cosign, Notary), reproducible builds, and vulnerability scanning in CI.
Experience designing and operating OTA update mechanisms for distributed agents or edge software at scale — including staged rollouts, rollback, and delivery verification.
Ability to reason about correctness in opaque, customer-controlled environments where you cannot observe failure modes directly.

Team Building & Engineering Culture

Experience building or significantly growing an engineering team — including hiring, onboarding, and establishing engineering norms tailored for shipped software.
Proven ability to define and instill engineering culture: rigorous code review standards, robust testing across diverse customer environments, and a strong culture of ownership.
Drives high-impact architecture decisions rigorously — requires design documents, runs structured reviews, builds consensus, and ensures decisions account for customer environment variables.

Technical Expertise

Proficient in Go (preferred), Python, or C++.
Strong Linux OS-level operations: container runtimes, networking in corporate environments, systemd, process isolation.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines for building and signing container images (cosign, Notary v2, or equivalent).
Familiarity with OTA update protocols and frameworks: TUF (The Update Framework), Omaha, or custom mechanisms.
Understanding of TLS, certificate pinning, and secure software delivery in hostile network environments.

Nice to Haves

Exposure to cybersecurity, pentesting tools, or vulnerability remediation.
Experience with cross-platform agents (Windows/Linux) and endpoint telemetry.
Background in software running in air-gapped or restricted network environments.
Familiarity with SLSA supply chain security framework.

Travel Required

We are a fully remote company, and this job may require up to 5% of travel to be successful.

Compensation And Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State's transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

Base salary range: $242,250 - $275,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.
Additional compensation: This role may also be eligible for an equity package (in the form of stock options). If any other compensation benefits apply, they will be discussed during the interview process.

Perks of Horizon3.ai

Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.
Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.
Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.
Remote Work: We are a 100% remote company. Enjoy the flexibility to work in the way that supports you and brings out your best.
Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary and benefits which includes health, vision & dental care for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

The Affera Mapping and Ablation System is an innovative medical technology designed to treat patients with cardiac arrhythmias. Once identified, the Affera Ablation System delivers targeted energy to disrupt these abnormal signals, restoring normal heart rhythm.

Fitch Group is currently seeking a Cloud AI Platform Architect (Anthropic and OpenAI) to join our Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering team in New York

As a leading, global financial information services provider, Fitch Group delivers vital credit and risk insights, robust data, and dynamic tools to champion more efficient, transparent financial markets. With over 100 years of experience and colleagues in over 30 countries, Fitch Group’s culture of credibility, independence, and transparency is embedded throughout its structure, which includes Fitch Ratings, one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, and Fitch Solutions, a leading provider of insights, data and analytics. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.

At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. It is the strength of our business. It comes from people around the world in a shared pursuit: to equal something greater than they could ever accomplish alone. Every team member is essential to our business and every perspective is critical for our success. Develop yourself in a culture that values flexibility, expects your opinion and trusts your decisions. Together we evolve and so will you, in an environment that asks you to challenge yourself – and us.

About The Team

This is a leadership role within Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering , serving as subject matter expert in Enterprise AI Deployment. This team owns Core DevOps Tools, Cloud Platform Engineering, Networking, and Reliability Engineering for all Fitch Group businesses. The role is responsible for the enterprise configuration, and operationalization of machine learning and large ‑ language ‑ model platforms , with a primary focus on platforms such as Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI, Databricks, and Snowflake . This role owns how these platforms are securely provisioned, governed, monitored, and scaled across multiple organizations, environments, and use cases .

How You’ll Make An Impact

Sitting at the intersection of DevOps, emerging technology, technical operations, and information security , this role ensures that foundation-model platforms are production ‑ ready : highly available , cost ‑ controlled , compliant, and easy for engineering and business teams to consume safely.
The role is not focused on building applications or prompts, but on designing and running the underlying AI platforms that everything else depends on. They partner with Core Engineering and Reliability Engineering squads to integrate AI platforms into the larger Cloud ecosystem at Fitch.
Enable self ‑ service access for approved teams, with guardrails that prevent misconfiguration or policy violations.
Evaluate new capabilities from Anthropic and OpenAI (e.g., advanced agent features, new models, tooling changes) and determine enterprise readiness. Enable safe experimentation with these as well as competing services.
Influence vendor roadmap discussions by bringing an enterprise platform perspective.
Establish guardrails for cost management and forecasting , working with TechOps and Finance where needed.
Partner closely with Information Security and Technology Operations to embed security, privacy, and data controls into AI platform configurations.
Implement and enforce: Role ‑ based access and segregation of duties , Data handling and retention controls, Model usage boundaries and red ‑ line capabilities
Support auditability and compliance requirements by ensuring AI usage is logged, traceable, and reviewable.
Serve as the technical owner for translating policy into enforceable platform controls .
Establish Infrastructure ‑ as ‑ Code and configuration ‑ as ‑ code approaches for AI platform provisioning where possible.
Partner with SRE and TechOps teams to ensure platform reliability, scalability, and operational maturity.

You May Be a Good Fit If

You have hands-on experience deploying or operating Anthropic and/or OpenAI in enterprise or production environments.
Experience providing AI services via Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud
Strong background in DevOps, platform engineering, or cloud infrastructure , with an understanding of how to productionize developer platforms.
Experience partnering with Information Security on access controls, governance, and risk management.
Practical experience with API platforms, environment separation, and multi ‑ tenant or multi ‑ org designs.
Ability to balance innovation speed with operational discipline and safety.
Strong written communication skills for documenting platform standards, guardrails, and operating models.

What Would Make You Stand Out

Experience supporting AI platforms in regulated or risk ‑ sensitive environments .
Familiarity with agentic AI patterns, orchestration layers, or AI platform governance models.
Background providing services to large organizations with multiple business units
A track record of creating architecture diagrams, design documentation, standards, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-transfer materials that improve supportability and reduce single points of expertise .

Why Choose Fitch

Hybrid Work Environment: 2 to 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location
A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
Promoting Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
Inclusive Work Environment: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe

added.description:
About Infinitive

Infinitive is a data & AI consultancy that enables global brands to deliver results through insights, innovation, and efficiency. We possess deep industry and technology expertise to drive and sustain adoption of new capabilities. We match our people and personalities to our clients' culture while bringing the right mix of talent and skills to enable high return on investment.

Infinitive has been named “Best Small Firms to Work For” by Consulting Magazine eight times, and has also been named a Washington Post Top Workplace, Washington Business Journal Best Places to Work, and Virginia Business Best Places to Work.

Role Overview

This architect will define and shape a unified platform service that enables scalable, governed, and cost-efficient data access across the bank. The ideal candidate will influence enterprise design standards and technical adoption by making Databricks Unity Catalog the effortless, observable, and default foundation for data integration, governance, and analytics across all business domains.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Vision & Architecture

Define and champion the end-to-end architecture for the bank’s Databricks-based data platform, ensuring scalability, security, cost efficiency, and ease of adoption
Design a self-service platform layer that leverages Databricks Unity Catalog to deliver seamless data discovery, access, and observability across all environments
Establish architectural patterns and reference implementations that encourage enterprise-wide reuse and standardization

Unity Catalog Strategy & Enablement

Lead the design and implementation of Databricks Unity Catalog as the central governance plane—defining catalog hierarchies, fine-grained access controls, and cross-environment lineage
Evaluate and implement metadata, RBAC/ABAC, and data masking capabilities to meet regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., GLBA, GDPR, HIPAA)
Define the template architecture that allows Unity Catalog to operate as a scalable and cost-effective shared service across lines of business

Scalability, Cost, and Observability

Engineer platform capabilities that provide deep visibility into compute, storage, and catalog operations through integrated observability, monitoring, and FinOps practices
Develop resource optimization strategies to balance performance and cost while maintaining compliance and SLAs
Establish metrics, dashboards, and alerts to ensure the platform scales predictably under enterprise workloads

API and Integration Design

Architect streamlined RESTful/GraphQL APIs for secure, governed data access and metadata integration
Ensure interoperability with enterprise systems, APIs, and external data consumers using modern, consistent, and documented integration patterns

Data Modeling & Pipeline Strategy

Guide teams in building Lakehouse-aligned data models that maximize reuse and governance
Oversee design of ETL/ELT architectures (Spark, PySpark, SQL) that integrate seamlessly with Unity Catalog for lineage and access tracking

Collaboration & Influence

Partner with engineering, data science, and risk teams to align platform design with business outcomes and regulatory expectations
Influence architecture steering committees and platform engineering groups to adopt the Databricks foundation as a managed, enterprise-wide service
Promote a culture of easy adoption through clear design patterns, documentation, and working sessions

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

Mentor engineers and architects on Databricks, Unity Catalog, and best practices for cost, scale, and observability
Contribute to internal architecture communities and upskill teams across multiple domains

Required Skills & Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
Experience: 8+ years in data architecture or platform engineering, including experience designing enterprise-scale, distributed data environments
Databricks Expertise: Deep hands-on knowledge of Databricks, Delta Lake, Apache Spark, and Lakehouse principles
Unity Catalog Mastery: Demonstrated success architecting and operationalizing Databricks Unity Catalog for enterprise governance, metadata management, and access control
Programming & Data: Advanced proficiency in Python (PySpark) and SQL; experience with cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
API Engineering: Strong background in API architecture (REST, GraphQL, OpenAPI) and applying best-in-class security and observability
Governance Knowledge: Expert-level understanding of data governance frameworks, data quality management, and regulatory compliance
Soft Skills: Outstanding communication and influence skills, with ability to advocate for design principles across executive, technical, and risk audiences

Preferred Qualifications

Experience deploying Databricks and cloud infrastructure using Terraform or IaC frameworks
Familiarity with MLflow and model governance integration
Relevant certifications (Databricks Certified Data Engineer, AWS/Azure/GCP Architect)
Experience with real-time data streaming technologies (Kafka, Structured Streaming)

added.title: IT Service Delivery Manager – API Platform, Developer Portal & Emerging AI Gateway - Sr.
added.description:
Description

At Huntington, we're building the next generation of banking experiences, and our API platform is at the heart of that transformation.

We're looking for an experienced and inspirational technology leader to lead our API Gateway and Developer Portal teams while helping shape the future of our emerging AI Gateway capabilities. This leader will be responsible for delivering secure, reliable, and scalable shared technology platforms that enable engineers across Huntington to build, integrate, and innovate with confidence.

This is an opportunity to lead enterprise-scale platforms that power critical business capabilities across the organization while influencing the next generation of API and AI-enabled technology services.

What You'll Do At Huntington (Duties / Responsibilities)

As an IT Service Delivery Manager – API Platform, Developer Portal & Emerging AI Gateway, you'll have the opportunity to:

Lead a high-performing engineering team responsible for Huntington's Apigee-based API Gateway and Developer Portal, supporting critical enterprise capabilities 24x7x365.
Be accountable for end-to-end technology delivery execution, including staffing, planning, engineering execution, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across assigned platforms.
Develop and execute the long-term strategy and roadmap for Huntington's API Gateway, Developer Portal, and related platform capabilities in partnership with Product Management, Architecture, and Security.
Achieve outstanding availability, reliability, scalability, resiliency, and performance through proactive engineering, automation, observability, and operational discipline.
Own platform health, service delivery, operational readiness, incident management, and disaster recovery preparedness for supported services.
Collaborate with architecture, product management, security, and engineering teams to ensure a well-defined and executable roadmap that aligns with enterprise priorities.
Own the full API lifecycle, including onboarding, governance, security controls, monitoring, analytics, adoption, and continuous improvement.
Champion developer experience by making the Developer Portal the enterprise destination for API discovery, onboarding, documentation, testing, and integration enablement.
Drive platform adoption through developer engagement, standards, training, documentation, and enablement activities.
Work closely with product managers, architects, and security teams to build a best-in-class API ecosystem that enables internal agility and external connectivity.
Partner with architecture, product management, security, and AI engineering teams to support the evolution of Huntington's AI Gateway capabilities, helping establish secure, governed, and scalable access to approved AI services across the enterprise.
Foster a culture of technical excellence by coaching engineers, promoting modern engineering practices, and encouraging innovation, automation, and continuous learning.
Establish and monitor operational, reliability, and adoption metrics that demonstrate platform value, service quality, engineering efficiency, and business impact.
Responsible for financial transparency across IT, including platform operations, initiatives, forecasting, and resource planning.
Evaluate and validate business drivers and priorities and communicate delivery roadmaps, in partnership with Product Managers and Product Owners, across the organization.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Why This Role Matters

At Huntington, our API Gateway and Developer Portal serve as foundational capabilities that accelerate delivery, improve consistency, and enable secure integration across the enterprise. As Huntington expands its use of AI technologies, this role will also play an important part in helping establish the platform capabilities and operational practices required to enable responsible AI adoption at scale.

If you're looking for an opportunity where your leadership can influence technology capabilities used across the entire organization, we'd love to talk with you.

What You’ll Bring ( Basic Qualifications)

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
Minimum 10 years of related technology experience with at least 3+ years in a leadership or management role.
Proven experience leading software engineering, platform engineering, or shared technology teams.
Demonstrated experience delivering and operating highly available enterprise platforms and services.
Deep hands-on expertise with Apigee X, including policy development, traffic management, security, observability, and analytics.
Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, OAuth 2.0, JWT, API security, and API governance best practices.
Experience with developer portal technologies such as ReadMe, Apigee Developer Portal, or equivalent developer enablement platforms.

Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure), and modern observability practices.
Strong understanding of platform operations, service reliability, incident management, capacity planning, and operational excellence.
Proven ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, architecture, product management, security, and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Passion for developer experience, platform thinking, modern architecture, and engineering excellence.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value.
Experience managing enterprise shared services or platform capabilities supporting multiple business segments.
Exposure to AI platforms, Generative AI technologies, AI gateways, model-serving platforms, or enterprise AI governance frameworks.
Experience implementing technology governance, security, and risk controls within regulated environments.
Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries.
Proven ability to lead transformational platform initiatives while building high-performing teams and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Yes

Office

Workplace Type

Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. Remote roles will also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for moments that matter. Specific work arrangements will be provided by the hiring team.

93,000.00 - 189,000.00 USD Annual
