This position is incentive eligible.

Do you want to join an organization that invests in you as a Director Data Engineering and Data Management? At HCA Healthcare, you come first. HCA Healthcare has committed up to $300 million in programs to support our incredible team members over the course of three years.

Job Summary And Qualifications

The Director of Data Engineering and Data Management is responsible for leading the strategy, development, governance, and delivery of HR data assets that enable reporting, analytics, self-service insights, and emerging AI-enabled capabilities. This role provides technical and organizational leadership across data engineering, data modeling, metadata management, data quality, and governance practices. Working closely with HR, IT, Enterprise Data, and Analytics teams, the Director translates business needs into scalable, trusted, and reusable data products. The role is accountable for modernizing data delivery practices, establishing technical standards, and ensuring HR data assets are secure, well-governed, and positioned to support enterprise reporting, advanced analytics, and future AI initiatives.

This role will work a hybrid schedule out of our Capital View office in Nashville, TN.

Major Responsibilities:

Lead the design, governance, and lifecycle management of HR data products, data models, metadata, master data, lineage, and quality standards.
Partner with HR, Enterprise Data, IT, BI, and Analytics teams to translate business requirements into scalable data products, data models, metadata standards, quality controls, and delivery priorities.
Serve as HR's primary liaison to the Enterprise Data Office, influencing priorities, validating delivered solutions, and ensuring alignment with HR business requirements.
Establish data product roadmaps, priorities, and delivery plans aligned with HR and enterprise strategic objectives.
Lead the design and governance of HR data models, curated datasets, master data structures, semantic-layer enablement, metadata, lineage, and quality standards.
Drive modernization of HR data assets through cloud-native architecture, automation, DataOps practices, and reusable engineering patterns.
Provide technical oversight of data pipelines, transformation logic, SQL development, and data quality processes to ensure trusted and scalable data delivery.
Establish and mature data governance, stewardship, documentation, and ownership practices across HR data domains.
Build and develop a high-performing technical team while fostering accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
Evaluate and prepare HR data assets for emerging AI, automation, and advanced analytics use cases.

Education & Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Analytics, or related field required
3+ years of experience in leadership role required
3-5+ years of experience leading technical data teams or complex cross-functional data initiatives required
7+ years of experience in progressive experience with data engineering, analytics engineering, data architecture, data management, BI engineering, or related data roles preferred
Experience supporting HR, workforce, healthcare, or other highly governed data domains preferred
Demonstrated experience designing, modernizing, and governing enterprise-scale data assets preferred
Experience with Google Cloud Platform preferred
Experience partnering with centralized data, architecture, IT, governance, or AI teams in a complex enterprise environment preferred
Experience managing or developing technical analysts, analytics engineers, data engineers, or architecture resources preferred
Experience with data governance, metadata management, MDM, and data quality programs preferred

Licenses, Certifications, & Training:

Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect certification preferred
Relevant certifications in data governance, analytics engineering, cloud architecture, data quality, or Power BI preferred

Benefits

HCA Healthcare offers a total rewards package that supports the health, life, career and retirement of our colleagues. The available plans and programs include:

Comprehensive benefits for medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, behavioral health and telemedicine services
Wellbeing support, including free counseling and referral services
Time away from work programs for paid time off, paid family leave, long- and short-term disability coverage and leaves of absence
Savings and retirement resources, including a 401(k) Plan with a 100% match on 3% to 9% of pay (based on years of service), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, flexible spending accounts, preferred banking partnerships, retirement readiness tools, rollover support and financial wellbeing counseling
Education support through tuition assistance, student loan assistance, certification support, dependent scholarships and a partnership with Galen College of Nursing
Additional benefits for fertility and family building, adoption assistance, life insurance, supplemental health protection plans, auto and home insurance, legal counseling, identity theft protection and consumer discounts

added.title: Director Systems Engineering 1
added.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 50% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is a trusted provider of mission-enabling solutions for global security.  Our Engineering and Sciences (E&S) organization pushes the boundaries of innovation, redefines engineering capabilities, and drives advances in various sciences. Our team is chartered to provide the skills, innovative technologies to develop, design, produce and sustain optimized product lines across the sector while providing a decisive advantage to the warfighter.  Come be a part of our mission!

What You Get To Do

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems (NGMS) seeks to fill a Director of Engineering 1 position based in either Charlottesville, VA or Sykesville, MD. In this role, the selected candidate will report to the Naval and Oceanic Systems Senior Director of Engineering and Sciences and will be responsible for the overall direction, leadership, and management of the Naval engineering organization; a team comprised of approximately 250 managers, engineers, and scientists of varying levels of experience and growth across 3 sites: Charlottesville VA, Sykesville MD, and Ocean Springs MS.  The organization comprises Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Software Engineering, and Integration & Logistics.

The selected candidate must be able to work collaboratively with other E&S and business leaders, as well as other enabling functions to meet our commitments and address/resolve challenges in a timely manner.

This leadership role is pivotal in the development of hardware, software and systems solutions as well as production support and shipboard integration and test for Navy and USCG surface and subsurface fleet.

Key Responsibilities

Develop, lead, and execute engineering strategy aligned with business and program objectives for Naval systems programs.
Provide functional leadership to include goal setting, performance management, employee development, and managing budgets required to perform their statements of work.
Manage multiple sites’ workload forecast for engineering while meeting utilization goals
Drive innovation and engineering rigor across complex programs in all phases: concept development, design, integration, verification, deployment, and sustainment.
Enhance the personnel, processes, and tools to meet the current and future needs of the programs and technologies.
Provide oversight and leadership across all engineering disciplines, ensuring technical excellence, cost-effective execution, and alignment with customer needs.
Proactively push information and issues to business and functional leadership
Serve as the engineering authority for Naval systems programs, engaging regularly with internal stakeholders, senior leadership, government customers, and prime contractors.
Lead the development, design, implementation, application, training, costing, and product support for state-of-the-art solutions in support of captures, programs, and research & development.
Foster a high-performance culture that promotes technical depth, continuous learning, operational discipline, and talent development across departments.
Ensure compliance with engineering policies, quality standards, and risk management practices.
Support business growth through technical solutioning, proposal development, and customer engagement.
Support the sites’ Program Management teams in the successful execution of programs while meeting cost, schedule and customer performance requirements
Provide technical oversight to program risk and opportunity management boards

This position will be on-site at either Charlottesville, VA or Sykesville, MD locations

There will be up to 50% travel for this position to other Northrop Grumman locations.

Basic Qualifications Director 1 Position

Bachelor’s degree in engineering (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Software, Systems) or a related technical field with 12+ years of professional relevant experience; or a Master’s degree in engineering (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Software, Systems) or a related technical field with 10+ years of professional relevant experience.
Experience delivering complex hardware and software integrated systems within cost, schedule, and performance objectives.
Demonstrated ability to drive engineering performance, process discipline, and staff development in a matrixed organization.
Proficiency in technical problem solving to include decomposition, root cause analysis, and corrective actions development, implementation, and progress checks.
Previous experience in Functional People Management including staffing, metrics, training resources, processes, and tools
Experience briefing high level management, executives, and customers
Active Secret clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain a Top-Secret security clearance
U.S. citizenship required

Preferred Qualifications For Director 1 Position

Master’s degree in engineering, Engineering Management, Systems Engineering, or related technical discipline.
12+ years of experience in Aerospace & Defense in maritime domain
Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Agile software development, and digital engineering practices.
Experience with Product Lifecycle Management processes and tools
Familiarity with Department of Defense (DoD) acquisition lifecycle and the Systems Engineering lifecycle milestone reviews, e.g., System Requirements Review, Critical Design Review).
Experience as a Control Account Manager (CAM) including certification.

Primary Level Salary Range: $193,800.00 - $321,100.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

For our complete EEO and pay transparency statement, please visit http://www.northropgrumman.com/EEO. U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.

added.title: Vice President of Technology, DAT iQ
added.description:
About DAT

DAT
is an award-winning employer of choice and a next-generation SaaS technology company that has been at the leading edge of innovation in transportation supply chain logistics for 45 years. We continue to transform the industry year over year, by deploying a suite of software solutions to millions of customers every day - customers who depend on DAT for the most relevant data and most accurate insights to help them make smarter business decisions and run their companies more profitably. We operate the largest marketplace of its kind in North America, with 400 million freights posted in 2022, and a database of $150 billion of annual global shipment market transaction data. Our headquarters are in Denver, CO, with additional offices in Missouri, Oregon, and Bangalore, India. For additional information, see www.DAT.com/company.

The Opportunity

DAT's rate data is the reference price for truckload freight, and brokers, shippers, and carriers price against it every day. DAT iQ is the analytics product suite built on that position. Holding that position takes a leader who can sit with a brokerage's pricing team and explain how our rates are built. That leader owns the DAT iQ portfolio and the teams behind it, and partners with our broker and shipper leadership on where analytics takes the business.

Reports to the Chief Technology Officer.

What You’ll Do

Lead the DAT iQ product and engineering organization. Develop the product managers and engineering leaders who report to you, hire against the gaps, and set the standard for how the group operates.
Strengthen the product management practice. Raise the bar on how this team does discovery, decides what to build, defines success before it ships, and measures adoption after. Own the roadmap and the prioritization that produces it.
Own delivery and product quality. Our customers price freight against these numbers every day, so accuracy, latency, and reliability are the product. Carry accountability for what ships, when it ships, and how it performs in production.
Set the analytics strategy and deliver against it. Define how we extend and defend our data advantage, and translate that into an architecture and a roadmap the business can commit to.
Turn models into products. Partner with our data science organization to take forecasting and rate models from research into production, and own the engineering that makes them dependable at scale.
Serve as the analytics partner to our segment leadership. Own the products and data their plans depend on, and determine where the portfolio leans when broker and shipper priorities diverge.
Be in front of customers. Spend real time with brokers and shippers in their own operations, represent DAT iQ at industry events, and turn what you hear from our customer advisory forums into portfolio decisions.
Own how analytics is packaged and priced. Work through metering and packaging with our commercial and pricing teams as the portfolio evolves

The Skills And Experience You’ll Bring

Leadership of product and engineering organizations. You have led both functions together, developed managers and senior individual contributors, and hired well at that level. You give a team strategic and organizational direction without absorbing their work.
Delivery discipline. You have a record of predictable delivery and durable production quality, and you can say what you measure to know whether a team is healthy and why those are the right measures.
Product management depth. You have built or materially raised a product management practice: discovery, prioritization, defining success before launch, and measuring adoption after.
Freight market expertise. You understand how the truckload spot and contract markets operate: how capacity moves, why lanes behave differently, what bid season does to pricing, and how a broker decides what to accept.
Fluency with data and models. You have built or governed rate or forecasting models. Building them yourself is not required, but you can judge whether one is ready for production and hold a substantive conversation about sampling, coverage, latency, and revision behavior.
Sustained customer engagement. You have owned direct relationships with customers over years, meeting them in their own operations and bringing what you learned back into product and market decisions.
Commercial judgment. You understand how a brokerage makes money and where a number changes a margin decision, and you can reason through how analytics is metered, packaged, and priced as a portfolio matures.
Influence across the business. You can write a strategy that holds up in front of a leadership team, work with segment leaders whose plans compete with each other, and hold a standard with senior peers without taking over their decisions.

What Will Set You Apart

Established relationships with pricing leaders at brokerages.
Experience inside a brokerage or a shipper, using rate data to make pricing decisions.
Experience designing how data products are delivered to AI agents instead of to people.
Fluency with AI tools in your own day-to-day work.

Why DAT?

DAT is an award winning employer of choice.

For starters, we have a hybrid work environment, but we also know what makes a great workplace. We have a time-tested and resolute set of operating values predicated on integrity, mutual respect, open communication, and executing with excellence. These values inform our strategic vision as much as any one of our products does. We’ve been an employer of choice in the Portland metropolitan area for four decades, and within one year of opening our Denver office, DAT was #26 on Built In Colorado’s 100 Best Places to Work In Colorado.

A division of ASSA ABLOY — the world's leading access solutions company — we process nearly 100 million transactions per year across thousands of locations worldwide. We are at an inflection point: expanding our product portfolio into access control, smart locks, and commercial security; integrating acquired technologies; embedding AI across the business; and scaling our platform with the world's largest logistics, retail, and real estate enterprises. We're building the executive team to take us there.

Position Overview

The VP of Software Engineering is the technology executive for the Luxer One division — responsible for software engineering, cloud architecture, infrastructure/DevOps, firmware and embedded systems integration, and the systems that connect our growing product portfolio to the world.
As the division expands beyond package management into access control, smart locks, sensors, and commercial security products, this role will be central to integrating acquired technologies, consolidating platforms across brands, and executing the division's IP and technology strategy. Reporting directly to the Division President and seated on the executive leadership team, this is a business leadership role as much as a technical one — designed for an engineering executive who can design an organization, develop leaders, drive architectural evolution, and help the business make better decisions through clear technical judgment.

What You'll Own

Technology Strategy, Architecture & IP

Set the engineering direction for Luxer One's technology platform across all product lines, brands, and market segments — including access control, smart locks, sensors, and emerging commercial security products.
Own architecture decisions for cloud infrastructure, SaaS platforms, APIs, integrations, mobile applications, firmware/embedded systems, and connected product technology.
Lead technology consolidation across acquired and legacy platforms — identifying redundancy, rationalizing the stack, and driving toward a coherent, scalable architecture.
Partner with business and legal leadership to develop and execute the division's IP strategy — protecting proprietary technology, supporting patent development, and informing licensing and platform decisions.
Lead the engineering organization's AI strategy, from developer productivity tooling to application-layer AI capabilities embedded in our products.

Portfolio Expansion & M&A Integration

Evaluate acquired and partner technology platforms for architectural fit, integration complexity, and consolidation path.

ICON is looking for a Senior Director of Information Technology and Systems to build and own a unified technology strategy across a fast-growing, multi-division company. You will lead ICON's corporate IT, infrastructure, and information security functions, ensuring our technology stack drives business innovation, protects our systems and data, and scales with the company.
ICON operates across Construction, Technology, and Public Sector divisions, and builds robotic construction systems that are themselves connected, networked products. You will define the boundary between our enterprise environment and our product environment, set the strategy for commercial and government-regulated work, and scale support through automation and smart architecture rather than headcount ratios as ICON grows significantly over the next two years.
You'll be a senior voice in executive decisions about technology. When leadership weighs a major choice, such as moving infrastructure on-premises or extending government-grade controls across the company, you'll lay out the cost, resourcing, risk, and second- and third-order impacts so the decision is made with full context, and you'll push back when the tradeoffs warrant it.

Lead and develop the IT, infrastructure, and security teams, including hiring and developing team leads, setting operating principles, and defining service level agreements.
Own the multi-year roadmap for AI tooling and core digital infrastructure, aligned to ICON's divisional strategies and growth plans.
Advise executive leadership on major technology decisions, presenting cost, resourcing, security, and organizational impacts in decision terms.
Lead change management for company-wide technology shifts, including potential expansion of government-regulated environments across the business.

updated.title: Director of Data Center Field Engineering
updated.description:
About the role

We are seeking an experienced Director of Data Center Field Engineering to lead a growing North America organization responsible for field delivery across enterprise, large scale, mission critical, colocation, and hyperscale Data Center environments. The Director leads through three Practice Leads and is accountable for the overall workforce, partner ecosystem, delivery performance, organizational capability, and operating health of the Data Center Field Engineering organization.
This is a leader of leaders role. The Director is expected to build the organization and operating capability required to support growth while maintaining strong execution, quality, accountability, workforce readiness, and financial discipline. The role works across Professional Services, project delivery, technical teams, resource management, partners, and business leadership to ensure the organization can support what the business is committing to deliver.

What you'll be doing

Lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable three Data Center Field Engineering Practice Leads.
Set clear expectations for leadership, workforce readiness, utilization, delivery health, quality, performance management, and accountability across the organization.
Maintain a forward looking view of demand, capacity, skills, geography, workforce risk, and future hiring or partner requirements.
Build workforce strategies that use the right mix of employees, contractors, and delivery partners based on demand, capability, cost, location, and risk.
Maintain a Data Center partner ecosystem with the capability, capacity, geographic coverage, quality, and union or non-union support required by the delivery model.
Maintain visibility to major customer engagements, delivery risks, resource issues, partner concerns, quality trends, and escalations.
Provide leadership on major delivery issues that require organizational, workforce, partner, or cross functional decisions.
Drive consistent adoption of Field Engineering delivery methods, tools, quality expectations, escalation practices, and operating processes.
Monitor utilization, workforce cost, partner spend, labor mix, productivity, capacity, and other operating measures and use them to make informed decisions.
Partner with Finance, Resource Management, PMO, RDD, Solutions, Sales, Costing and Estimating, Partner Management, and other delivery leaders.
Support major opportunities and programs by validating that proposed delivery dates, workforce models, field leadership, partner assumptions, and Field Engineering costs are practical and executable.
Build leadership depth, succession plans, and development priorities so the organization can scale without depending on a small number of individuals.
Identify recurring delivery or operating issues and drive corrective actions that improve the broader organization.
Strong understanding of Data Center infrastructure deployment and field execution in active, construction, commissioning, colocation, mission critical, or hyperscale environments.
Working knowledge of rack installation, rack build, land and level, equipment integration, structured cabling, cable management, and related physical infrastructure activities.
Working knowledge of fiber and copper installation, routing, dressing, termination, testing, patching, labeling, documentation, and acceptance expectations.
Understanding of site readiness, surveys, migrations, commissioning support, quality evidence, closeout, and customer specific execution requirements.
Experience leading organizations that use a blended workforce of internal technical leaders, field resources, contractors, and delivery partners.
Understanding of the operating requirements associated with large scale programs, rapid workforce ramp, geographic coverage, and partner-based execution.

What you have

At least 10 years of Field Engineering, Data Center infrastructure delivery, Professional Services, technical services, or related experience; 12-15+ years preferred.
At least 5 years of experience leading managers, leaders, or large distributed technical teams.
Experience leading an organization of comparable size and complexity across multiple geographies or customer programs.
Experience supporting large scale or hyperscale Data Center programs strongly preferred.
Strong workforce planning, capacity management, utilization, performance management, and organizational leadership experience.
Experience developing and managing partner-based delivery models.
Strong financial and operational acumen, including the ability to connect workforce and partner decisions to utilization, cost, productivity, and delivery performance.
Demonstrated ability to lead through other leaders rather than personally managing every project or escalation.
Ability to work effectively across technical, operational, commercial, and executive teams.
Strong communication, judgment, decision making, and organizational skills.
Ability to operate in a fast-moving environment where customer demand, resource requirements, and delivery priorities can change quickly.

What you can expect

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. In addition to offering competitive compensation plans and long-term career opportunities, we provide an attractive mix of benefit plans to contribute to your good health, future financial security, and peace of mind.
